fields.title: Abasajja Abaalunda Ekisibo
fields.description: Zuula omutima ogw’omu Byawandiikibwa ogw’okuyitibwa okw’obusumba nga bwe guli ddala: okuliisa abalumwa enjala, okunoonya ababuze, n’okukuuma ekisibo. Oba oli mukulembeze eyakaddiwa mu buweereza oba oli munoonyi ayagala okumanya, ebyafaayo bino bijja kukoleezaamu okwagala okw’amaanyi eri Omusumba Omulungi n’abantu be.

qa.question: Ekitabo Abasajja Abaalunda Ekisibo kyogera ku ki?
qa.answer: Kibikkula omutima ogw’omu Byawandiikibwa ogw’okuyitibwa okw’obusumba — okuliisa abalumwa enjala, okunoonya ababuze, n’okukuuma ekisibo — nga kiyita mu bulamu bw’abasumba abeesigwa ab’abantu ba Katonda. Oba omusomi mukulembeze eyakaddiwa mu buweereza oba munoonyi ayagala okumanya, ebyafaayo by’ekitabo bigenderera okukoleezaamu okwagala okw’amaanyi eri Omusumba Omulungi n’eri abantu b’akwasa abasumba be abali wansi we.

qa.question: ‘Okuyitibwa okw’obusumba’ ekitabo kye kyogerako kye ki?
qa.answer: Gwe mulimu gw’omusumba alabirira abantu ba Katonda: okubaliisa amazima, okunoonya abawabye n’ababuze, okukuuma ekisibo eri akabi, n’okulabirira abanafu n’abalumwa. Ekitabo kino ekyokulabirako kino kikiggya mu bifaananyi by’obusumba Ebyawandiikibwa byennyini bye biraga, nga kiraga okulabirira emyoyo ng’okuyitibwa okw’ekitiibwa era okw’omuwendo omungi, okwagobererwa ku Kristo yennyini.

qa.question: Ekitabo kiyigiriza kitya obulamu bw’obusumba?
qa.answer: Okusinga kiyigiriza nga kiyita mu byafaayo — obulamu bw’abasajja abaalunda ekisibo kya Katonda n’obwesigwa — so si mu kuyigiriza okw’ebigambo obugambo. Bwe kiraga okuyitibwa okw’obusumba nga kutambulirwamu mu bulamu obwa ddala, ekitabo kiyigiriza bye kutwaliramu era ne kikubiriza omutima okukwagala, ng’ebyokulabirako ebya ddala eby’okulunda bikoleeza mu musomi okwagala okw’amaanyi eri omulimu ogwo n’eri abantu gwe guweereza.

qa.question: Omusumba Omulungi ekitabo gwe kisonga ye ani?
qa.answer: Ye Yesu Kristo, eyeeyita Omusumba Omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga. Ekitabo kiraga buli musumba omuntu omwesigwa ng’omusumba ali wansi wa Kristo, aggya gy’ali ekyokulabirako kye n’amaanyi ge. Bwe kityo ekigendererwa ky’ebyafaayo si kwewuunya basumba bokka, wabula okwongera okwagala kw’omusomi eri Omusumba gwe baweereza.

qa.question: Ekitabo kino kyawandiikirwa ani?
qa.answer: Kyawandiikirwa ‘abakulembeze abaakaddiwa mu buweereza’ era n’‘abanoonyi abaagala okumanya’ — abasumba n’abakulembeze b’Ekikristaayo abeetisse omugugu gw’omusumba, n’abakkiriza aba bulijjo abaagala okutegeera n’okussaamu ekitiibwa okuyitibwa okw’obusumba. Ebyafaayo byakyo byogera eri buli muntu afaayo ku ngeri abantu ba Katonda gye baliisibwamu, gye banoonyezebwamu, ne gye bakuumibwamu, era ne ku mutima omulimu ogwo gwe gwetaaga.

qa.question: Ekitabo kigamba nti omutima gw’omusumba gufaanana gutya?
qa.answer: Mutima oguliisa abalumwa enjala, ogunoonya ababuze, era ogukuuma ekisibo — omugumiikiriza, ogwewaayo, era ogwabumbibwa okwagala eri endiga n’eri Omusumba waazo. Ekitabo kiraga okuyitibwa kuno nga ‘kwa ddala’ era okw’omu Byawandiikibwa, so si nga mulimu gwa kitongole oba ogw’okwerabisa obulungi, nga kusimbiddwa mu kulabirira okw’omuwendo omungi Ebyawandiikibwa kwe biraga era Kristo kwe yatambuliramu.

qa.question: Kikwatagana kitya n’ebitabo ebirala ebya ‘Abasajja’ ebigenda nabyo?
qa.answer: Kye kimu ku kibinja ky’ebitabo ebikuŋŋaanya ebyafaayo ebiraga enjuyi ez’enjawulo ez’obusajja obw’Ekikristaayo obwesigwa n’okuyitibwa — abasajja b’okusaba, abaanyeenya eggulu, abaawaayo byonna, ne wano abasajja abaalunda ekisibo. Byonna awamu bikuŋŋaanya ebyokulabirako ebisikiriza omusomi okwewaayo n’omutima gwe gwonna, ate kino kissa essira ku mulimu gw’omusumba ogw’enjawulo: okulabirira abantu ba Katonda.

qa.question: Omusomi asaanye kutandikira wa?
qa.answer: Ku ntandikwa, oba ku bulamu bwonna obumusikiriza, kubanga essuula zisinga kweyimirirawo zokka. Bwe zisomebwa awamu, ebyafaayo bizimba ekifaananyi ky’okuyitibwa okw’obusumba ekigenderera okukoleeza okwagala eri Omusumba Omulungi n’ekisibo kye. Noolwekyo ekitabo kisingira ddala kugasa bwe kisomebwa n’okufumiitiriza, so si okunoonya obunoonya amawulire.

fields.title: Ennyanjula: Obuzito n’Ekitiibwa eky’Okuyitibwa okw’Obusumba
fields.body_html:
Tewali kuyitibwa kulala kufaanana nakwo. Omusumba ayimiridde we bisisinkanira ebitaggwaawo n’eby’obulijjo — ekigere ekimu mu tterekero ly’ebitabo by’eddiini, ekirala mu kisenge ky’eddwaliro; omukono ogumu ku Byawandiikibwa, ogwokubiri ku kibegabega ky’omuntu obulamu bwe bwe bukyakamala okumenyekamenyeka. Mu kiseera kye kimu ye muyizi, omubuulizi, omuwi w’amagezi, omubudaabuzi, omukulembeze era omuweereza. Asitula obuzito bw’emyoyo. Wansi wa Katonda, y’avunaanyizibwa okuliisa n’okukuuma mu mwoyo abantu abaliyimirira lumu mu maaso g’Omuyinza w’Ebintu Byonna — era akimanyi. Abasajja ab’omu kitabo kino baawulira obuzito obwo, ne babukkiriza, era olw’ekisa kya Katonda ne babutuukiriza n’obwesigwa ebyafaayo bwe bitasobodde kwerabira.

Okuyitibwa okw’obusumba si kuyiiya kwa muntu. Kukulukuta butereevu okuva mu mutima gwa Katonda, eyeeyoleka mu Byawandiikibwa byonna okuva ku ntandikwa okutuuka ku nkomerero ng’omusumba. Ekifaananyi ekyo kirabika buli wamu.

Isaaya yawulira ekisuubizo kya Katonda: “Aliisa ekisibo kye ng’omusumba, akuŋŋaanya abaana b’endiga mu mukono gwe n’abasitula mu kifuba kye, n’akulembera mpola mpola ezibayonsa.” (Isaaya 40:11). Nga tannawa Kkanisa basumba ba bantu abakola wansi we, Katonda yasooka kulaga mpisa ye ey’obusumba ng’ekyokulabirako kye bandiyitiddwa okugoberera. Buli musumba eyali akaabye wamu ne nnamwandu ali mu nnaku, eyali anoonyezza emmeeme ewabye, oba eyali aliisizza n’obugumiikiriza abo abafa enjala mu mwoyo, yali akola ekyo ng’alaga ekifaananyi kya Katonda, ye kennyini Omusumba eyasooka era asinga obukulu.

Katonda teyakwatibwa nsonyi kuvunaana basumba ba bantu olw’okulabirira ekisibo kye. Ezeekyeri yawandiika ebimu ku bigambo ebisinga okufumita mu biwandiiko by’abannabbi — ebigambo ebitaagambibwa bakaafiiri wabula abakulembeze ba Isirayiri bennyini: “Zibasanze abasumba ba Isirayiri abeefaako bokka. Abasumba tebasaanye kuliisa ndiga? Mulya amasavu, ne mwambala ebyoya, ne mutta ensolo ensava, naye temufaayo ku bisibo. Ennafu temuzizzaamu maanyi, so n’endwadde temuzijjanjabye, so n’ezirumizibbwa temusibye biwundu byazo, so n’ezibuze temuzikomezzaawo” (Ezeekyeri 34:2–4). Omusango guno Katonda gwe yasala, bw’ogusoma okuva ku ludda olulala, gwe gusinga okunnyonnyola mu bujjuvu omulimu gw’obuweereza obw’obusumba obw’obwesigwa ogwali gukyawandiikibwa. Omusumba omulungi akola ddala buli kimu ekyogerwako wano nti kyalagajjalirwa.

Omusumba omulungi y’aliwa? Okusookera ddala si mwogezi akubiriza bantu, si mukulembeze wa kibiina kya bwannakyewa, era si muzannyi asanyusa abantu mu by’omwoyo. Musajja Katonda gwe yayita okuliisa, okukuuma, okukulembera n’okwagala ekibinja ky’abantu ekigere ekyamukwasibwa — si mu kiseera eky’okwenoonyeza ebibye, wabula mu lugendo oluwanvu olw’obuweereza obw’obwesigwa. Abasajja ekkumi ab’omu kitabo kino tebaafuna birabo bye bimu, tebaasoma kyenkanyi, era empisa zaabwe tezaafaanagana. Chrysostom yabwatuka ng’eggulu okuva ku kituuti ekinene eky’e Constantinople, n’agobebwa mu buwaŋŋanguse olw’okugaana okuwaanawaana ab’obuyinza. George Herbert yawandiika ennyimba mu kyalo ekitono, n’afa ng’aweza emyaka amakumi asatu mu mwenda ng’amaze okukikyusa. Richard Baxter yakyalira buli maka mu Kidderminster ng’alina katekisimu n’okukakasa okwaka ng’omuliro nti tewali mmeeme mu kitundu kye esaanye kuzikirira olw’obutafibwako musumba. Dietrich Bonhoeffer yaddukanya mu kyama essomero ly’abasumba eryali ligaaniddwa amateeka, era n’akkiriza okuwanikibwa ku kalabba mu kifo ky’okwonoona obwesimbu bw’Ekkanisa gye yali aweereza.

Okukuutira kw’omutume Pawulo eri abakadde b’e Efeso kukyali kwe kusinga okunnyonnyola kye kwetaaga okuyitibwa okw’obusumba: “Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna Mwoyo Mutukuvu mwe yabateeka okuba abalabirizi okulabiriranga Ekkanisa ya Katonda gye yeegulira n’omusaayi gwe.” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28). Mu kiragiro kino ebintu bibiri tebiyinza kwawukana: omusumba alina okusooka okwekuuma yekka — emmeeme ye, okutambula kwe ne Katonda, n’obwesimbu bwe — n’alyoka akuuma ekisibo. Omuntu tayinza kuwa ky’atalina. Omusumba ng’emmeeme ye yennyini erumwa enjala, mangu ddala aliremwa okuliisa abo b’alabirira. Abasajja ab’omu kitabo kino ekyo baakitegeera.

Ebibala by’obusumba bwabwe tebyayawukana ku kwewaayo kwabwe eri Katonda mu bulamu bwabwe obw’omunda.

Okuyigiriza kwa Peetero eri abakadde kulimu obuzito bw’ekiragiro n’ebbugumu ly’okuyita: “Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe, mukiriisenga nga mukirabirira n’okwagala so si na kwemulugunya, nga mukolerera amagoba ag’obukuusa wabula olw’okujjumbira Katonda. Be mukulembera temubakambuwaliranga wabula mubakulemberenga nga mubalaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi. Era Omusumba Omukulu bw’alikomawo, muliweebwa engule ey’ekitiibwa ekitaliggwaawo.” (1 Peetero 5:2–4). Ekisuubizo ekyo eky’enkomerero — engule etaggwaawo okuva mu mukono gw’Omusumba Omukulu yennyini — kye kyanyweza abasajja bano ekkumi okuyita mu myaka amakumi n’amakumi egy’obuweereza obutalabika, obw’ebbeeyi, era emirundi mingi obutasiimibwa. Tebaakolera kukubirwa mu ngalo bantu. Baakoleranga Omu yekka abalaba.

Essuula zino si nfumo za kugulumiza batukuvu. Tezeefuula nti abasajja bano baali tebaliiko kamogo wadde okulemererwa. Abamu ku bo baakola ensobi ez’amaanyi; abalala baalina obunafu bwe baakkiriza mu biwandiiko byabwe bennyini n’obwerufu obulumya. Kye baagabana tekyali kutuukirira, wabula okussaayo ennyo omwoyo ku kuyitibwa okw’obusumba — okukakasa nti okukwasibwa okulabirira emyoyo gwe mulimu ogusinga obuzito omuntu gw’ayinza okusitula, n’okumalirira okugutuukiriza, olw’ekisa kya Katonda, n’amaanyi gaabwe gonna.

Empapula zino ziwandiikiddwa abasumba n’abo ababaagala. Ziwandiikiddwa abayizi b’eddiini abakyasalawo omuweereza ow’engeri ki gwe banaaba, abakadde abeebuuza obanga obwesigwa bwabwe obusirifu mu buweereza bulina kye bugasa, n’ab’ekkanisa abaagala okutegeera okuyitibwa kw’omusajja ayimirira mu maaso gaabwe buli wiiki. Okusinga byonna, ziwandiikiddwa buli muntu yenna ayaayaanira okulunda — mu ngeri yonna, ku bunene bwonna — mu mwoyo gw’Oyo eyagamba nti, “Nze musumba omulungi.”

fields.title: John Chrysostom — Omusumba ow’Omumwa ogwa Zaabu
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

John Chrysostom yazaalibwa nga mu 347 AD mu Antioch eky’e Suuli, nga mutabani w’omukungu w’eggye, era n’afuna okusoma okusinga obulungi okwali kuyinzika mu mulembe gwe, nga tannakyuka kuyingira mu bulamu bw’Ekikristaayo obw’okwefiiriza wansi w’omulabirizi Meletius. Yamala emyaka egyamubumba ng’omumonaki mu ddungu ly’e Suuli, n’oluvannyuma n’akomawo e Antioch, ebirabo bye eby’okubuulira gye byasikiriza ebibiina ebinene, ne bimuweesa erinnya ebyafaayo lye bimujjukirirako, lye yaweebwa ng’amaze okufa: Chrysostom, “Omumwa ogwa Zaabu.” Mu 398 AD, Omukama Arcadius yamulonda okuba Ssaabalabirizi wa Constantinople nga si by’ayagala, era Chrysostom n’akkiriza omulimu ogwo n’obutereevu bwe bumu bwe yalina mu buli kimu: amangu ddala n’atunda eby’ebbeeyi ebyali mu lubiri lw’omulabirizi, ensimbi n’azizimbisa amalwaliro g’abaavu, n’agoba abaweereza b’ekkanisa abalyi b’enguzi, era n’atandika okubuulira buli Ssande — eri mukyala w’omukama ne eri omusabiriza n’obutereevu bwe bumu. Okugaana kwe okuwaanawaana ab’obuyinza kwamuleetera okugobebwa mu buwaŋŋanguse emirundi ebiri, era ogw’okubiri gwe gwamutta; yafa mu 407 AD ng’akakibwa okutambula mu nsozi z’e Pontus.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Chrysostom yanywerera kye kimu ku nsonga nti okubuulira okw’obwesigwa gwe mutima gw’obuweereza obw’obusumba ogutayinza kuteesebwako. Omusumba ataliisa kisibo na Kigambo yali musumba mu linnya lyokka. Tebyali bya kwolesa bukugu mu kwogera, wabula bikolwa bya busumba — okuliisa ekisibo n’obwegendereza, obutakoowa n’obugumiikiriza.

Enjigiriza ye ey’obusumba ku baavu yali emu ku bye yasinga okuleeta eby’enjawulo era ebisinga okusaba ebingi.

Chrysostom yakkiriza nti engeri ekibiina gye kiyisaamu abaavu kye kipimo ekituufu eky’engeri gye kitegeddemu Enjiri. Ekibuulirwa kye ku Matayo 25 — mwe yannyonnyolera amakulu ageewuunyisa nti Kristo aliwo mu buli muntu alumwa enjala, alumwa ennyonta, n’atalina waka — kyali kimu ku bibuulirwa by’obusumba ebisinga okukubiriza abantu okufaayo ku bannaabwe mu byafaayo by’Ekikristaayo.

Yawandiika nti: “Oyagala okuwa ekitiibwa omubiri gwa Kristo? Tomubuusa maaso ng’ali bwereere. Tomusinza mu yeekaalu ng’oyambadde liiri n’oluvannyuma n’omulagajjalira ebweru gy’abonaabonera n’empewo n’obwereere.” Kino teyakisinziira ku ndowooza z’abantu ez’embeera z’ensi, wabula ku kulangirira kwa Pawulo: “Tewakyali kusosola wakati wa Muyudaaya na Muyonaani, wakati wa muddu na wa ddembe, wakati wa musajja na mukazi, kubanga mwenna muli omu mu Kristo Yesu.” (Abaggalatiya 3:28). Ekibiina ky’abakkiriza ekitwala olunyiriri luno nga lukulu, bwe yagamba, tekiyinza kubuusa maaso kubonaabona kw’omubiri okwa buli omu ku bammemba baakyo.

Chrysostom era ye yali omuyigiriza omukulu ow’obuvumu mu busumba. Yalaba abasumba bangi abaamwetoolodde nga babalirira n’obwegendereza amazima bameka ge bayinza okubuulira nga tebanyiizizza abo abaawagiranga ekkanisa. Obuweereza obw’engeri eyo yabutwala nga bwa nsonyi ddala. Omusumba yalina kuvunaanyizibwa si ku kitiibwa kye mu bantu, wabula ku myoyo gy’alabirira, era emyoyo egyo gyetaaga amazima — ne bwe gaba nga tegaagalibwa, naddala olwo.

Yanywerera ku kulabula kwa Pawulo awatali kukyukakyuka: “Kubanga ekiseera kijja lwe baligaana okuwulira enjigiriza entuufu, era olw’okugoberera okwegomba kwabwe balyekuŋŋaanyiza abayigiriza, abalibayigiriza bye baagala, okuwulira.” (2 Timoseewo 4:3). Chrysostom yagaana okuba omu ku bayigiriza abo. Okugobebwa kwe emirundi ebiri gwe gwali omuwendo gw’okugaana okwo, era yagusasula nga teyeemulugunya.

Obusika bwe obw’obusumba obw’enkomerero bwali ekyokulabirako ky’okufa kwe. Ng’agobebwa abaserikale okuyita mu nsozi mu butiti obw’omu kiseera ky’amakoola okugwa, ng’anafuye nnyo obutasobola kutambula, yafa n’ebigambo bye bimu ku mimwa gye ebyali bitandise obuweereza bwe: “Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda olw’ebintu byonna.” Kwali kufa kwa busumba mu makulu gaakwo gonna — okufa okwabuulira. Okumala obuweereza bwe bwonna yali ayigirizza ekibiina kye nti okubonaabona tekukontana na kwagala kwa Katonda, wabula kwe kugabana mu bya Kristo. Kaakano n’abalaga bwe kifaanana mu musajja eyakikkiriza. Yali atambulidde mu bujulirwa bwa Pawulo: “Mu buli mbeera gye mbaamu nayiga okumalibwanga.” (Abafiripi 4:11). Ddala bwe yali. Era yali ayigirizza ekisibo kye, mu kigambo ne mu kyokulabirako, okukola kye kimu.

Essaala

Mukama waffe Yesu, Omusumba Omulungi, tuwe obuvumu bwa Chrysostom — okubuulira Ekigambo nga kyagalibwa ne bwe kitaagalibwa, okuyimirira wakati w’abantu baffe n’emisege ka kibe ki kye tufiirwa, n’okwagala abaavu si ng’omulimu gwe tukola wabula nga Ggwe kennyini. Tufuule abasumba abeetegefu okuwaayo obuweerero bwaffe, erinnya lyaffe, n’okwewummuza kwaffe nga tuweereza ekisibo ky’Otukwasizza okulabirira.

Amiina.

fields.title: Gregory Omukulu — Omuweereza w’Abaweereza
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Gregory yazaalibwa nga mu 540 AD mu Rome mu emu ku nnyumba ez’ab’ekitiibwa ezisinga obumanyifu mu kibuga, era nga tannayitawo myaka amakumi asatu, yali amaze okulinnya okuba Prefect wa Rome — ekifo ekisinga obukulu mu bufuzi bw’ekibuga. Ku ntikko y’emirimu gye egy’obufuzi, yakyuka mu ngeri ey’ekitalo n’ayingira obulamu bw’abamonaki, ettaka ly’ab’ewaabwe ku Lusozi Caelian n’alifuula ekigo ky’abamonaki, era n’amala emyaka etaano mu bulamu obw’okufumiitiriza bwe yali ayagadde ebbanga lyonna. Nga si by’ayagala, Paapa Pelagius II yamuggya mu kigo ky’abamonaki okumutuma mu mirimu gy’obubaka, n’oluvannyuma, mu 590 AD, abaweereza b’ekkanisa n’abantu ba Rome ne balonda Gregory yennyini okuba paapa. Yakkiriza ng’alina ennaku ey’amazima — mu bbaluwa ze yeeyogerako ng’eyawalulwa okuva mu bulamu obw’okufumiitiriza n’asuulibwa mu “nnyanja y’ensi” — naye n’afuga Ekkanisa ey’Ebugwanjuba okumala emyaka kkumi n’ena egyaddirira n’obukugu n’amagezi g’obusumba ebyamufuula, mu ndaba y’ebyafaayo, si “Omukulu” kyokka, wabula ekyokulabirako ekikulu eky’obukulembeze bw’obusumba obw’Ekikristaayo okumala emyaka lukumi egyaddirira. Yeeyitanga “Omuweereza w’abaweereza ba Katonda,” ekitiibwa ba paapa kye bakyakozesa ne leero.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Ekiwandiiko kya Gregory ku busumba, “Liber Regulae Pastoralis” (Ekitabo ky’Etteeka ly’Obusumba), kye yawandiika mu myezi egyasooka egy’obupaapa bwe, kiyinza okuba nga kye kitabo ekimu ekisinga okubaako kye kikoze ku buweereza obw’obusumba mu byafaayo by’Ekikristaayo. Kabaka Alfred Omukulu yakivvuunula mu Lungereza olw’edda. Kyabumba entegeera y’obuweereza mu Kkanisa yonna ey’omu mirembe egy’omu makkati. Ekirowoozo kyakyo ekikulu — nti omusumba alina okumanya buli ndiga mu ngeri yaayo, bw’atyo n’aweereza buli emu mu ngeri yaayo — kikyasoomooza era kikyali kya mazima leero nga bwe kyali Gregory we yakiwandiikira. Okulabirira okw’obusumba okulungi, bwe yagamba, si kukozesa nkola emu ku bantu bonna, wabula kwe kwawula buli muntu, mu mbeera ye, ky’asinga okwetaaga okuva eri Katonda.

Okukakasa okw’omusingi kwa Gregory ku busumba kwasimba emirandira mu kifaananyi ky’omusumba eky’abannabbi b’Abaebbulaniya, naddala essuula ya Ezeekyeri ennene ey’abasumba. Ekisuubizo kya Katonda mu Ezeekyeri 34 eri Gregory tekyali kunnyonnyola kwa bunnabbi okukwata ku Kristo kwokka, wabula kyali kifaananyi abasumba ba bantu abakola wansi we kye baalina okugoberera: “Ndinoonya ezaabula, ne nkomyawo ezaawaba. Ndigyanjaba ezaalumizibwa, ne ŋŋumya ennafu, naye ensava era ez’amaanyi ndizizikiriza. Ndirunda ekisibo mu bwenkanya.” (Ezeekyeri 34:16). Buli kikolwa mu lunyiriri luno eri Gregory kyali buvunaanyizibwa bwa busumba: okunoonya, okukomyawo, okujjanjaba, okuzaamu amaanyi, okukola eby’obwenkanya. Omusumba omulungi yali akola, so si wa kutuula butuuzi — ng’agenda eri ababuze mu kifo ky’okubalindirira okudda, ng’asiba ebiwundu mu kifo ky’okubibuusa amaaso, ng’azaamu ennafu amaanyi mu kifo ky’okujaguza ab’amaanyi bokka.

Ekitundu ky’enjigiriza ya Gregory ku busumba ekyasinga okukyusa ebintu mu bikolwa kwali kunywerera kwe ku kulabirira buli muntu mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Omuntu atidde yeetaaga kuzzibwamu maanyi; omwenyumirizi yeetaaga kunenyezebwa. Omwavu yeetaaga kubudaabudibwa; omugagga yeetaaga kulabulwa. Omulamu yeetaaga kuyigirizibwa; omulwadde yeetaaga bugumiikiriza. Okukozesa engeri y’emu ey’obusumba ku bonna bano tekwali magezi ga busumba wabula bugayaavu bwa busumba. Ekyokulabirako ky’enjawulo eno yakisanga mu Pawulo bwe yannyonnyola obuweereza bwe: “Mu banafu nafuuka ng’omunafu ndyoke mbaleete eri Kristo. Eri abantu bonna nfuuse byonna, mu ngeri yonna ndyoke mbeeko beentusa ku kulokolebwa.” (1 Abakkolinso 9:22). Kino tekyali kukyukakyuka wadde okwegonza eri abantu — gaali magezi ga busumba, obukugu bw’okumanya eddagala lyetaagisa ku mbeera ki.

Enjigiriza ya Gregory ku bwetoowaze bw’omusumba yali ya buziba bwe bumu. Yalina ekifo ekisinga obukulu mu Kkanisa ey’Ebugwanjuba, naye n’alonda okweyita ebigambo ebyakyusa mu bugenderevu amagezi g’obuyinza bw’abantu: “Buli ayagala okubeera omukulu mu mmwe, abeerenga muweereza wa banne. Na buli ayagala okuba omwami mu mmwe aweerezenga banne ng’omuddu waabwe. Mube nga Omwana w’Omuntu atajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi.” (Matayo 20:26–28). Gregory yakkiriza nti obuyinza bw’omusumba tebukendeezebwa buweereza obw’obwetoowaze, wabula bwe bubuzimba. Omulabirizi eyakozesanga ekifo kye okwekuŋŋaanyiza ebirungi teyali akozesa buyinza bwa busumba; yali abufuula bwereere. Omuweereza w’abaweereza ye, mu buweereza bwe bwennyini, yali asinga ddala okuba n’obuyinza obw’amazima mu kisenge.

Gregory era yategeera nti ekifo ky’omusumba kyetaaga obulamu bw’omwoyo obw’omutindo ogusinga obugulumivu. Omusumba yali tayinza kuyita kisibo kye kuyingira mu kwewaayo okw’obuziba ye kennyini mw’atayingiranga. Kabaka Alfred Omukulu yakivvuunula mu Lungereza olw’edda. Kyabumba entegeera y’obuweereza mu Kkanisa yonna ey’omu mirembe egy’omu makkati. fields.title: George Herbert — Omusumba w’Ekyalo Eyafuula Eby’Obulijjo Ebitukuvu
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

George Herbert yazaalibwa nga Apuli 3, 1593, mu Montgomery eky’e Wales, mu nnyumba y’Abangereza ey’ekitiibwa, era n’afuna okusoma okw’ekitalo mu Westminster School ne mu Trinity College, Cambridge, gye yasembyeyo okulondebwa okuba Public Orator (Omwogezi wa Yunivasite) — ekifo ekyamuleetera okukwatagananga bulijjo n’embuga ya Kabaka James I, era ekyalabika ng’ekimusuubiza ekitiibwa mu nsi.

Okumala emyaka yaziyiza okuyitibwa mu buweereza obw’obusumba, ng’atayagala kuleka kitiibwa ky’olukale, naye mu 1630, ng’aweza emyaka amakumi asatu mu mukaaga, n’akkiriza okuba omusumba w’ekkanisa entono ey’ekyalo e Bemerton mu Wiltshire, okumpi ne Salisbury. Yali asigazza emyaka esatu gyokka — yafa olw’akafuba mu 1633 ng’aweza emyaka amakumi asatu mu mwenda — naye emyaka egyo esatu gyazaala ebyo bangi bye batwala ng’ennyimba ez’okwewaayo ezisinga obulungi mu Lungereza, n’ekiwandiiko ekiluŋŋamya obuweereza obw’obusumba mu byalo, “A Priest to the Temple, or The Country Parson,” ekikyali ekyokulabirako eky’obwetoowaze, okufaayo, n’obuyiiya bw’omusumba n’okutuusa leero.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Entegeera ya Herbert ku buweereza obw’obusumba teyayawukana ku ndowooza ye ey’obubonero obutukuvu: okukakasa nti ebintu ebya bulijjo eby’obulamu bw’omuntu — ekijjulo, ennimiro, olweyo, ekitanda — bisobola okusitula obuzito bw’amakulu ga Katonda. Kino tekyali by’ekyama bya mwoyo, wabula enjigiriza ya Kristo okujja mu mubiri: Katonda eyambala omubiri n’abeera mu kyalo ye Katonda eyali mu mbeera za buli lunaku ez’obulamu bw’ab’ekkanisa ye, era omulimu gw’omusumba gwali kubayamba okumulaba eyo.

Omusumba w’ekyalo teyali muntu akka olumu na lumu okuva ku ntikko z’eby’omwoyo okwogera ku by’ensi; yali omu abeera wakati mu bantu be n’abayamba okuzuula ebitukuvu ebiri mu makkati gaabwe.

Ekifaananyi Herbert ky’akuba eky’omusumba w’ekyalo mu kiwandiiko kye kyewuunyisa olw’engeri gye kissa essira ku kubeerawo kw’omusumba. Omusumba alina okumanyibwa abantu be si ng’omugenyi ajja olumu na lumu oba ekya Ssande yokka, wabula nga muliraanwa, mukwano, era munne bakola mu ttaka lye limu. Yakozesa ekifaananyi kya Pawulo ekijjudde okwagala eky’omukazi ayonsa: “Nga nnyina w’abaana bwe yandyagadde abaana be, bwe tutyo bwe twabalumirwa omwoyo ne tusanyuka okubatuusaako si Enjiri ya Katonda yokka naye n’okuwaayo emyoyo gyaffe ffe, kubanga mwafuuka baagalwa baffe.” (1 Basessaloniika 2:7–8). Okugabana obulamu kuno — so si bimanyisa byokka — Herbert yakkiriza nti kwe kwawula obuweereza obw’obusumba ku kusomesa obusomesa. Omusumba agabana obulamu bwe n’abantu be abaagala mu ngeri Pawulo gye yannyonnyola: si ng’abawuliriza ab’okuyigirizibwa wabula ng’abaana ab’okulabirirwa.

Mu The Country Parson yanywerera ku nsonga nti amaka g’omusumba gennyini galina okuba ekibuulirwa. Ennyumba y’omusumba yalina okufugibwa okusaba, okusembeza abagenyi, obwangu, n’entegeka ey’obutukuvu, buli ayingiramu awulire empisa ez’enjawulo ku ezo ezifuga ensi ey’ebweru. Mukyala w’omusumba yali munne mu buweereza buno; abaana be baali bibala byabwo ebibereberye; emmeeza ye yali eggule eri omwavu asinga mu kkanisa ye. Herbert kino yakisinziira ku bisaanyizo Pawulo bye yassaawo eri omulabirizi: “Omulabirizi kimugwanira okuba nga taliiko kya kunenyezebwa, nga musajja wa mukazi omu, nga muntu eyeefuga, nga mwegendereza, nga mukwata mpola, ayaniriza abagenyi, era ng’amanyi okuyigiriza. Tateekwa kuba mutamiivu” (1 Timoseewo 3:2–3). Bino eri Herbert tebyali birungi bya mu bwongo, wabula mpisa za bulamu bwa buli lunaku — buli emu, bw’ekolebwa obutayosa, ng’ebumba amaka okuba obujulizi obulabika obuwolereza Enjiri.

Ennyimba za Herbert ez’obusumba — ezaakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu The Temple, ezaafulumizibwa ng’amaze okufa — nazo zaali kya kukozesa mu busumba. Yawandiika ennyimba ezaawa ab’ekkanisa ye ebigambo ku bye baali bawulidde naye nga tebasobola kubyogera: okukalira mu mwoyo, okuwulira nti tosaanira kwagala kwa Katonda, okufuba okusaba, n’okuzuula nti Katonda abadde aliwo mu mbeera ze baali balowooza nti yazivaamu. Oluyimba lwe olukulu “Love (III)” — mwe Okwagala (Kristo) kwaniriza ku mmeeza emmeeme etayagala wadde ng’egamba nti tesaanira — lwakwata mu nnyiriri kkumi na nnya ekyo Pawulo kye yatwala essuula yonna okukibikkula: “Kubanga Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza aleme kuzikirira, wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo.” (Yokaana 3:16).

Obukugu bwa Herbert mu busumba bwali mu kuvvuunula amazima gano amanene mu mbeera z’obulamu ab’ekkanisa ye ze baali babeeramu ddala.

Era yali musumba ow’obugumiikiriza obungi eri abo abalwanagana, abalwawo okutegeera, n’abatabuse mu mwoyo. Yawandiika mu The Country Parson nti omusumba tateekwa kulaga kunyiiga eri abo abatategeera mangu, tateekwa kubawulizisa nga basirusiru olw’ebibuuzo byabwe, era ateekwa okujjukiranga bulijjo nti naye yennyini edda yali tamanyi bye amanyi kaakano. Ekyokulabirako kino yakisanga mu kuyigiriza kwa Pawulo: “Omuddu wa Mukama tasaana kulwana, wabula okuba omukkakkamu eri bonna, n’okuba omuyigiriza omulungi agumiikiriza, era aluŋŋamya n’obwetoowaze abo abamuwakanya, oboolyawo Katonda alibawa okwenenya, ne bamanya amazima” (2 Timoseewo 2:24–25). Obukkakkamu mu kuyigiriza tebwali kakodyo ka busumba eri Herbert, wabula okukakasa okw’enjigiriza ya Katonda: Katonda eyamugumiikiriza yamwetaagisa okugumiikiriza abalala.

Herbert yafa ng’aweza emyaka amakumi asatu mu mwenda, ng’alina obuweereza obumpi emabega we, n’ennyimba ntono ze yaweereza mukwano gwe n’obulagirizi nti zifulumizibwe kasita yandirowoozezza nti ziyinza okuyamba “emmeeme enaku eyennyamidde.” Zimaze kumpi emyaka ebikumi bina nga ziyamba emyoyo eminaku egyennyamidde. Yali atuukirizza okuyitibwa okw’obusumba mu ngeri Pawulo gye yannyonnyola: “Kristo oyo gwe tutegeeza nga tuyigiriza buli muntu mu magezi gonna era nga tulabula buli omu, tulyoke twanjule buli muntu eri Katonda ng’atuukiridde mu Kristo.” (Abakkolosaayi 1:28). Yali alangiridde, alabudde, era ayigirizza — mu bibuulirwa, mu biwandiiko, mu nnyimba, ne mu bulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku wakati mu bantu be. Okukula kwe yafubirira mu balala kwatuukirizibwa mu ye yennyini olw’ekisa kya Katonda gwe yaweereza.

Essaala

Mukama w’eby’obulijjo n’ebitukuvu, tuyigirize okukusanga mu mbeera z’obulamu bwa buli lunaku n’okuyamba abalala okukusanga eyo nabo. We tukemebwa okutwala obuweereza obutono nga tebutusaanira, tuwe obumativu bwa Herbert ku kisibo ekigere ky’otuwadde. Fuula amaka gaffe ebibuulirwa, emmeeza zaffe zibe nzigule, obugumiikiriza bwaffe buleme kuggwaawo, n’ebigambo byaffe — ne bwe biba bitono bitya — bisobole okuyamba emmeeme enaku eyennyamidde okuzuula ekkubo erigenda gy’Oli. Amiina.

Okugabana obulamu kuno — so si bimanyisa byokka — Herbert yakkiriza nti kwe kwawula obuweereza obw’obusumba ku kusomesa obusomesa. Omusumba agabana obulamu bwe n’abantu be abaagala mu ngeri Pawulo gye yannyonnyola: si ng’abawuliriza ab’okuyigirizibwa wabula ng’abaana ab’okulabirirwa. Mu The Country Parson yanywerera ku nsonga nti amaka g’omusumba gennyini galina okuba ekibuulirwa. Ennyumba y’omusumba yalina okufugibwa okusaba, okusembeza abagenyi, obwangu, n’entegeka ey’obutukuvu, buli ayingiramu awulire empisa ez’enjawulo ku ezo ezifuga ensi ey’ebweru. Mukyala w’omusumba yali munne mu buweereza buno; abaana be baali bibala byabwo ebibereberye; emmeeza ye yali eggule eri omwavu asinga mu kkanisa ye. Herbert kino yakisinziira ku bisaanyizo Pawulo bye yassaawo eri omulabirizi: “Omulabirizi kimugwanira okuba nga taliiko kya kunenyezebwa, nga musajja wa mukazi omu, nga muntu eyeefuga, nga mwegendereza, nga mukwata mpola, ayaniriza abagenyi, era ng’amanyi okuyigiriza. Tateekwa kuba mutamiivu” (1 Timoseewo 3:2–3). Yali atuukirizza okuyitibwa okw’obusumba mu ngeri Pawulo gye yannyonnyola: “Kristo oyo gwe tutegeeza nga tuyigiriza buli muntu mu magezi gonna era nga tulabula buli omu, tulyoke twanjule buli muntu eri Katonda ng’atuukiridde mu Kristo.” (Abakkolosaayi 1:28). Yali alangiridde, alabudde, era ayigirizza — mu bibuulirwa, mu biwandiiko, mu nnyimba, ne mu bulamu bwe obwa buli lunaku wakati mu bantu be. Okukula kwe yafubirira mu balala kwatuukirizibwa mu ye yennyini olw’ekisa kya Katonda gwe yaweereza. Essaala Mukama w’eby’obulijjo n’ebitukuvu, tuyigirize okukusanga mu mbeera z’obulamu bwa buli lunaku n’okuyamba abalala okukusanga eyo nabo. We tukemebwa okutwala obuweereza obutono nga tebutusaanira, tuwe obumativu bwa Herbert ku kisibo ekigere ky’otuwadde. Fuula amaka gaffe ebibuulirwa, emmeeza zaffe zibe nzigule, obugumiikiriza bwaffe buleme kuggwaawo, n’ebigambo byaffe — ne bwe biba bitono bitya — bisobole okuyamba emmeeme enaku eyennyamidde okuzuula ekkubo erigenda gy’Oli. Amiina.

fields.title: Richard Baxter — Omusumba Omuzzeemu Obuggya Eyatuuka ku Buli Luggi
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Richard Baxter yazaalibwa nga November 12, 1615, e Rowton mu Shropshire, mu Bungereza. Kitaawe yali mwami eyalimiranga ku ttaka lye, era okukyuka kwe okw’oluvannyuma okutuuka ku kukkiriza okw’Ekikristaayo okw’amazima kwabumba endowooza ya Richard omuto ku ddiini ey’amazima bw’efaanana. Eby’obwakatonda yabyeyigiriza okusinga ng’asoma ebitabo n’omululu, n’ayawulibwa, era mu 1641 n’afuuka omuweereza w’e Kidderminster — ekibuga ky’abantu enkumi bbiri, ekyali, nga ye kennyini bw’ayogera, kumpi nga tekirina ddiini n’akatono we yatuukira.

Bwe yavaayo emyaka kkumi n’ena oluvannyuma, ekibuga kyali kikyuse ddala: kumpi buli nnyumba yalina okusinza kw’amaka, enguudo zaawuluganga amaloboozi g’okuyimba, era ekibiina kyali kyeyongedde nnyo obungi ekkanisa n’eremwa okubagyamu. Kino teyakituukako mu nkuŋŋaana za kuzuukuka ez’ekitalo, wabula mu kukyalira buli maka mu kibuga, mu ntegeka, n’obugumiikiriza, omuntu ku muntu. Ekitabo kye “The Reformed Pastor,” ekyafulumizibwa mu 1656, kikyali kye kitabo ekisinga okwekenneenya obuvunaanyizibwa bw’omusumba mu lulimi Olungereza.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Endowooza ya Baxter ku busumba yazimbibwa ku kukkiriza kumu okwaka ng’omuliro: buli mwoyo mu kitundu kye gwali buvunaanyizibwa bwe mu maaso ga Katonda. Si emyoyo egyajjanga obutayosa. Si emyoyo egyali emyangu okutuukako. Buli mwoyo. Eri Baxter kino tekyali kwegomba kwa ddiini kwokka, wabula kye yeeyama mu nkola n’akituukiriza ng’asisinkana buli maka mu Kidderminster — amaka nga lunaana — omulundi gumu buli mwaka, ng’agayigiriza katekisimu ye kennyini, ng’apima embeera yaago ey’omwoyo, era ng’akola ku buli kye yasanga ng’ayigiriza, ng’abuulirira, era ng’asaba. Omulimu guno yaguyita omutima gw’obuweereza bwe, ogusinga obukulu okubuulira kwonna kwe yabuulira.

Omusingi gw’eby’obwakatonda ogwaleetera Baxter okukola omulimu gw’obusumba n’obwangu bwe butyo gwali enjigiriza y’omukuumi okuva mu Ezeekyeri — kimu ku bitundu by’Ebyawandiikibwa byonna ebisinga okwekebejja abalina obuvunaanyizibwa bw’obusumba: “Bwe ŋŋamba atali mutuukirivu nti, ‘Mazima tolirema kufa,’ n’otamulabula newaakubadde okwogera naye ng’omulabula alekeyo engeri ze ezitali za butuukirivu asobole okuwonya obulamu bwe, omuntu oyo atali mutuukirivu alifa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwe, naye omusaayi gwe ndiguvunaana ggwe. Naye bw’olirabula omuntu atali mutuukirivu, n’atalekaayo obutali butuukirivu, newaakubadde engeri ze embi, alifa olw’ekibi kye, naye obulamu bwo bulilokolebwa” (Ezeekyeri 3:18–19). Baxter kino yakitwala ng’ensonga ey’obulamu n’okufa. Omusaayi gw’emyoyo egizikirira olw’obutalabulwa musumba gwandivunaanibwa omusumba. Eno teyali njigiriza ewummuza mutima, naye Baxter teyanoonya kuwummula mu by’obwakatonda bye — yanoonya bwesigwa.

Ekigambo kye ekisinga okumanyibwa mu The Reformed Pastor kifunza endowooza ye yonna ku busumba: “Nnabuuliranga nga sikakasa nti ndiddamu okubuulira, era ng’omuntu afa ng’abuulira abantu abafa.” Kino tekyali kwongeza. Baxter yali mulwadde okumala ekitundu ekisinga eky’obuweereza bwe, emirundi mingi ng’akakasa nti okufa kumuli kumpi, era bw’atyo bwe yabuuliranga. Buli kubuulira kwali kuyinza okuba okw’enkomerero. Buli kukyalira maka kwali kuyinza okuba omukisa ogusembayo okwogera n’omwoyo ogwo nga tegunnayimirira mu maaso ga Katonda. Okwanguyiriza kuno tekwali kweraliikirira kwa kwekolera, wabula kukkiriza kwa by’obwakatonda nti ebiseera bitono ate obutaggwaawo buwanvu, era nti omusumba eyeerabira kino tasaanira kuyitibwa kwe. Ekiragiro kya Pawulo yakitwala nga bwe kiri ddala: “Nkukuutirira mu maaso ga Katonda ne Kristo Yesu, anaatera okusalira abalamu n’abafu omusango, era n’olw’okujja kwe, n’olw’obwakabaka bwe, buuliranga ekigambo kya Katonda, ng’oli mwetegefu mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu” (2 Timoseewo 4:1–2). Buli kiseera kyali kiseera ekituufu.

Baxter era yanyiikiriza nnyo nti embeera y’omwoyo gw’omusumba yennyini kye kisookerwako obuweereza bw’obusumba okubala ebibala. The Reformed Pastor yagitandika n’ekitundu ekyekenneenya ennyo obwetaavu bw’obutukuvu mu bulamu bw’omuweereza, ng’alaga nti omusumba alagajjalira omwoyo gwe tayonooneka mu bulamu bwe bwokka, wabula alemala n’obusumba bwe. Yajuliza Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28, n’alyoka annyonnyola ekitundu kyakyo ekisooka n’amaanyi agafumita: “Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna Mwoyo Mutukuvu mwe yabateeka okuba abalabirizi” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28). “Mwekumenga” kye kyasooka. Omusajja atasobola kukuuma mwoyo gwe yennyini teyalina kya kwegamba nti akuuma abalala.

Kino tekyali kintu kya kweronderamu ng’obuweereza tebunnatandika; kye kyali obukwakkulizo bwabwo.

Enkola ye ey’okukyalira amaka ng’ayigiriza katekisimu — ng’asisinkana amaka mu nnyumba zaago, ng’ayita mu bibuuzo ebikwata ku kukkiriza n’obulokozi, ng’azuula ebitategeerekese bulungi n’abitereeza n’Ebyawandiikibwa — yali evugibwa eby’obwakatonda eby’obuvunaanyizibwa bwa buli mukkiriza, bye yasanga mu nkola y’Endagaano Empya ey’okuyigirizagana. Yayagalanga nnyo obwesige Pawulo bwe yalina mu kibiina ky’e Ruumi: “Era matidde baganda bange, nze kennyini, nga nammwe bennyini mujjudde obulungi, nga mujjudde okutegeera kwonna, era nga muyinza okubuuliriragana” (Abaruumi 15:14).

Ekigendererwa ky’omulimu gwe ogw’obusumba omuntu ku muntu kyali kino ddala — okutuusa abantu b’ekitundu kye ku ddaala ery’okuyinza okuyigirizagana n’okubuuliriragana. Yali akolera okutuuka ku kiseera nga tebakyamwetaaga nnyo. Buli maka mu Kidderminster bwe gandisobodde okwekuumira obulamu bwago obw’omwoyo, nga mulimu gwe agukoze.

Omukululo gwa Baxter mu busumba gwali bukakafu nti omulimu gw’obusumba ogw’amazima era ogw’entegeka gukyusa ebitundu. Teyalinda kuzuukuka kujja mu Kidderminster; yakkiriza nti okufuba kw’obusumba okw’obwesigwa ye ngeri eya bulijjo Katonda gy’akozesa okuleeta okuzuukuka, era bw’atyo n’afuba. Obwesige bwe yabwesigamya ku kisuubizo kya Katonda yennyini mu Yeremiya: “Era ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala, abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera” (Yeremiya 3:15). Abasumba Katonda b’awa abakola ng’omutima gwe bwe gwagala bakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera — si mu bujjumbizi obwereere, si mu kuddukanya kitongole, wabula mu bukulembeze obugumiikiriza, obumanyi, era obufaayo ku buli muntu, obw’omusajja amanyi endiga ze amannya gaazo. Baxter yali amanyi buli maka mu Kidderminster. Yali amanyi amannya gaabwe, ebibalumya, ebibuuzo byabwe, n’embeera yaabwe ey’omwoyo. Era okuyita mu kumanya okwo, Katonda yakyusa ekibuga.

Essaala

Mukama, tufuule abasumba abawulira obuzito bwa buli mwoyo gwe tulabirira. Tuwonye okulimbibwa okuwummuza nti okubuulira n’obwesigwa kwokka kutuukiriza okuyitibwa kw’obusumba, era otugobe mu wofiisi zaffe otuyingize mu maka g’abantu baffe. Tuwe obwangu bwa Baxter — okubuulira ng’abantu abafa nga babuulira abantu abafa — n’obugumiikiriza bwe, okukyala, okuyigiriza katekisimu, okusaba, n’okukola nga bwe kiyinza okuba nti okukyala okuddako kwe kunaggulawo oluggi olumaze emyaka mingi nga luggaddwa. Amiina.

Essaala Mukama, tufuule abasumba abawulira obuzito bwa buli mwoyo gwe tulabirira. fields.title: Jonathan Edwards — Omukugu mu By’obwakatonda Eyalabirira Ekisibo Kye
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Jonathan Edwards yazaalibwa nga October 5, 1703, mu East Windsor, Connecticut, mutabani w’omuweereza wa kkanisa ya Congregational era muzzukulu wa Solomon Stoddard ow’e Northampton, omusajja ow’amaanyi.

Yayingira Yale ku myaka kkumi n’esatu, n’amaliriza ku kkumi na musanvu, era mu 1727 yeegatta ku kibiina kya jjajjaawe e Northampton, Massachusetts, ng’omusumba omuyambi. Yadda mu kifo kya Stoddard mu 1729, n’abeera e Northampton emyaka egisukka amakumi abiri okutuusa ekibiina kye lwe kyamugoba mu 1750 mu nkaayana enkambwe ku nkola y’Ekyeggulo kya Mukama — okugaanibwa kwe yagumira n’ekisa eky’ekitalo. Emyaka egyaddirira yagimala ng’omuminsani ku nsalo eri Abazaalirwa ba Amerika e Stockbridge, okutuusa mu 1757 lwe yalondebwa okuba pulezidenti wa College of New Jersey (kati Princeton). Yafa mu 1758, wiiki mukaaga nga yakatuuzibwa, olw’okugemebwa kawali okwagenda obubi, ku myaka amakumi ataano mu ena. Abangi bamutwala ng’omukugu mu by’obwakatonda era omufirosoofo asinga Amerika gw’ezaddeyo, naye okusooka n’okutuusa ku nkomerero yali musumba.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Endowooza ya Edwards ku busumba teyayawukana ku ndowooza ye ey’eby’obwakatonda, kubanga yakkiriza nti ekikolwa ky’obusumba ekisinga obuziba kwe kutuusa ku bantu amazima ga Katonda mu buziba bwago bwonna, mu bulungi bwago, ne mu ntiisa yaago. Ekibiina ekitegeera Katonda bw’ali — mu mazima, mu buziba, so si mu birowoozo byokka — kyandimwagadde era ne kimutya nga bwe kisaanidde, ne kitambula bwe kityo. N’olwekyo omulimu gw’omusumba ogusooka gwali gwa by’obwakatonda: okuyingiza abantu be mu kumanya okw’amazima okukyusa obulamu, okwa Katonda gwe beeyita okusinza. Yakkiriza nti okubuulira okutakwata ku magezi n’omutima wamu kwazaala eddiini ey’oku ngulu etandigumidde kunyigirizibwa kwa nsi.

Endowooza ya Edwards ku mulimu gwe yabumbibwa ennyonnyola ya Pawulo ey’ekitalo ku kigendererwa ky’omuweereza ekijjuvu: “Kristo oyo gwe tutegeeza nga tuyigiriza buli muntu mu magezi gonna era nga tulabula buli omu, tulyoke twanjule buli muntu eri Katonda ng’atuukiridde mu Kristo. Kyenva ntegana nga nfuba nga nkozesa obuyinza Katonda bw’ampa obw’amaanyi” (Abakkolosaayi 1:28–29). “Ng’atuukiridde mu Kristo” tekyali kigendererwa kitono. Kyetaaga omuntu yenna okukyuka — ebirowoozo, okusalawo, enneewulira, n’empisa — okufaanana ekifaananyi kya Kristo. Edwards yakifubirira e Northampton emyaka egisukka amakumi abiri, ng’abuulira, ng’ayigiriza, ng’abuulirira, era ng’awandiika, bulijjo ng’aluubirira kukula so si kujja mu kkanisa kwokka.

Okuzuukuka kwa 1734–1735 e Northampton, Edwards kwe yawandiikako mu A Faithful Narrative of the Surprising Work of God, kwamuleetera okusoomoozebwa kw’obusumba kwe yali ayinza okuba nga yasinga okwetegekera: okwawula okuzuukuka okw’omwoyo okw’amazima ku kw’enneewulira okw’obulimba.

Eky’okuddamu kye kyali okwawula okw’obusumba okusinga okwegendereza n’obuziba ennono y’Abapolotesitanti kwe yali ezzeeyo ku ebyo abantu bye bayitamu mu ddiini. Ebipimo bye yabisanga mu Byawandiikibwa: “Temuzikizanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu, era temunyoomanga abo aboogera eby’obunnabbi, naye mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga. Mwewalenga buli ngeri ya kibi” (1 Basessaloniika 5:19–22). Yagaana okuzikiza Omwoyo Omutukuvu ng’asuula buli kitali kya bulijjo nti bujjumbizi bwereere; era yagaana okukkiriza buli kya nneewulira nti kya mazima. Ekitabo kye Treatise Concerning Religious Affections kikyali kye kiragiro ky’obusumba ekisinga ku kwawula kuno.

Edwards era yategeera nti omulimu gw’obusumba gwetaaga okulangirira okuteesa kwa Katonda kwonna awatali kutya — nga mwe muli n’enjigiriza ezaanyiizanga abantu ab’ekitiibwa. Okubuulira kwe okw’ettutumu “Sinners in the Hands of an Angry God” batera okukwogerako ng’obukambwe bw’eby’obwakatonda, naye mu butuufu kyali kikolwa kya busumba eky’okwagala okulumwa: okugezaako okumenya obugayaavu bw’ekibiina ekyali kiteredde mu ngeri ey’akabi mu ddiini etaabaggyako kantu. Yali akola ddala Pawulo kye yakuutira: “kubanga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mbabuulira okwagala kwa Katonda” (Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:27). Ekyo kyonna Katonda ky’ayagala kyalimu n’omusango, era omusumba agulekayo teyakuumanga kibiina kye ku kunyiiga okutali kwetaagisa, wabula yakissanga mu kabi ak’emirembe gyonna.

Engeri gye yalabiriramu ekibiina oluvannyuma lw’okugobebwa kwe mu 1750 kye kimu ku bisinga okulaga obuweereza bwe. Yali agaaniddwa ekibiina kye yali aweerezza emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu. Okugobebwa okwo kwali kwa bulumi, kwa lwatu, era abasinga okwekenneenya ebyafaayo bagamba nti tekwali kwa bwenkanya. Naye yava e Northampton nga talina bukyayi, n’akwasa ekibiina kye okusaasira kwa Katonda, n’akisabiranga. Yali anywezezza bye yabuulira: nti obufuzi bwa Katonda butuuka ne ku bibaggyamu essuubi abasajja abeesigwa, era nti emirembe gy’omusumba tegyesigamye ku kusiimibwa kibiina. Yawummulira mu mbeera ya Katonda nga Pawulo bwe yaginnyonnyola: “Era tumanyi nga eri abo abaagala Katonda, era abo abayitibwa ng’okuteesa kwe bwe kuli, ebintu byonna bibatuukako olw’obulungi” (Abaruumi 8:28). Emyaka gye e Stockbridge ku nsalo, mwe yawandiikira ebimu ku biwandiiko bye ebisinga obukulu mu by’obwakatonda ng’atamanyiddwa era ng’ali mu bizibu, gyali bibala by’okukkiriza okwo.

Omukululo gwe ogw’olubeerera mu busumba bwali bukakafu nti obuziba bw’eby’obwakatonda n’okulabirira abantu tebikontana, naye tebyawukana. Ekibiina ekiriisibwa enneewulira yokka awatali musingi gwa by’obwakatonda kyandikuluggusiddwa ebizibu bwe bijja. Ekibiina ekiweebwa enjigiriza enkalu yokka awatali bubugumu bwa musumba kyandifudde enjala. Edwards yawa abantu be byombi — si bulijjo mu ngeri etuukiridde, naye bulijjo n’obunyiikivu — kubanga yakkiriza nti ennyonnyola ya Pawulo ku kukkiriza okukuze yeetaaga byombi: “Tube ba mazima mu kwagala, tulyoke tukulire mu Kristo mu byonna, nga tweyongera okuba nga ye, Omutwe gw’Ekkanisa” (Abaefeso 4:15). Amazima n’okwagala wamu: eyo ye yali endowooza ya Edwards ku busumba, era ekyali ndowooza buli muweereza omwesigwa gy’alina okuzzaawo mu buli mulembe.

Essaala

Ayi Katonda ow’amazima gonna n’okwagala kwonna, tuwe obuvumu bwa Edwards okubuulira okuteesa kwonna okw’Ekigambo kyo nga tetusazeemu bitundu ebitunyiiza, n’amagezi ge okwawula ekiva mu Mwoyo wo mu mazima. Tuyigirize okuluubirira, mu buli kikolwa kya busumba, okutuukirira kwa Kristo mu bulamu bw’abo be tuweereza. Era bwe tugobebwa oba bwe tuggwaamu essuubi, tuwummulire mu bufuzi bwo era tweyongere okusabira abo abaatugaana edda. Amiina.

fields.title: John Newton — Eyali Omusuubuzi w’Abaddu Eyalunda n’Ekisa
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

John Newton yazaalibwa nga August 4, 1725, mu London, mutabani w’omuduumizi w’emmeeri, era emyaka gye egisooka ng’omukulu yagimala mu nsi enkambwe ey’obusuubuzi bw’abaddu obwa Atlantic — okusooka ng’omuseeyeeyi eyakakibwa okukola, oluvannyuma ng’omukozi ku mmeeri, ate ku nkomerero ng’omuduumizi w’emmeeri ez’abaddu. Omuyaga ogw’entiisa mu 1748 gwaleeta akaseera akazibu akaatandika okukyuka kwe, era mu 1764 yayawulibwa okuba omuweereza mu Kkanisa ya England, n’aweereza ng’omusumba omuyambi e Olney mu Buckinghamshire okutuusa mu 1780. Ye ne William Cowper baawandiika wamu “Olney Hymns” ez’ettutumu, nga mwe muli ne “Amazing Grace,” era yawandiikiganya n’abantu bikumi na bikumi mu Bungereza yonna — ng’awandiika ebimu ku bbaluwa ez’obusumba ezisinga obubugumu n’amagezi ag’omugaso mu lulimi Olungereza. Emyaka amakumi abiri mu musanvu egyasembayo egy’obuweereza bwe yagimala ng’omusumba omukulu owa St. Mary Woolnoth mu London, gye yeeyongera okubuulira n’okubuulirira okutuusa kumpi n’okufa kwe mu 1807, ku myaka kinaana mu ebiri.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Obusumba bwa Newton tebwayawukana ku byafaayo bye. Nga bwe yategeezanga obulamu bwe bwonna, ye yali obukakafu obusinga nti ekisa kya Katonda kisinga buli kibi — ekintu kye yali tayinza kwerabira wadde okuleka ekibiina kye okukyerabira. Bwe yeeyogerako mu ngeri ey’ettutumu mu kiraamo kye — “John Newton, omuweereza w’ekkanisa, eyali edda atakkiriza era ow’empisa embi, omuweereza w’abaddu mu Afirika, yali, olw’okusaasira okungi okwa Mukama waffe era Omulokozi Yesu Kristo, akuumibwa, azzibwa obuggya, asonyiyibwa, era alondebwa okubuulira okukkiriza kwe yamala ebbanga ddene ng’afuba okuzikiriza” — tekwali kwetoowaza kwa bulimba, wabula lwe lugero olwafuga obuweereza bwe bwonna. Ye yali omwonoonyi asookera ddala. N’olwekyo yalina okusaasira okusinga obuziba eri abo abatawaana.

Ebbaluwa ez’obusumba Newton ze yawandiika mu buweereza bwe obuwanvu ze zimu ku bitereke ebisinga obugagga eby’okuluŋŋamya okw’omwoyo okw’omugaso mu Lungereza. Zaali za kitalo olw’okugatta obutuufu bw’enjigiriza n’obubugumu bw’omusumba — nga tazawula, nga takkiriza njigiriza kufuuka nnyogovu wadde obubugumu kufuuka nneewulira yokka. Yakolera ku kyokulabirako ky’abatume Pawulo kye yannyonnyola, eky’obukkakkamu n’okwagala kwa maama: “Naye twefuula ng’abaana abato mu maaso gammwe, nga nnyina w’abaana bwe yandyagadde abaana be” (1 Basessaloniika 2:7). Obukkakkamu buno tebwali bwa muntu atamanyangako kizikiza kya mazima, wabula bwa muntu eyakimanya mu buziba, ekisa ne kimutuukako ne bwe kyali kityo.

Yayinzanga okuwandiikira abo abaali baggwaamu essuubi mu mwoyo n’obuyinza obw’amazima: naye yali abaddeyo.

Kimu ku birabo bya Newton ebisinga okwawukana mu busumba kyali eby’obwakatonda bye ku mulimu gw’ekisa ogugenda mpola mu bulamu bw’Omukristaayo. Ebyogerwa ku kukula mu mwoyo okw’amangu era okw’ekitalo tebyamuwuniikirizanga, era yabuuliriranga okugumiikiriza eri ye yennyini n’eri abalala mu lugendo oluwanvu era olutali lwenkanankana olw’okutukuzibwa.

Yeegeraageranya, mu ngeri eyamanyika, ku muntu eyali aggiddwa ekitundu mu bbunwa ly’ebitosi: nga tannavaamu, naye ng’atunudde we kisaanidde era ng’agenda eri ettaka eriyonjo. Omusingi gw’okugumiikiriza kuno mu Byawandiikibwa yagusanga mu bujulizi bwa Pawulo yennyini: “Sigamba nti mmaze okufuna oba nti mmaze okutuukirira, wabula nfuba okufuna ekyo Kristo Yesu kye yagenderera nfune” (Abafiripi 3:12). Kino tekyali kwekwasa kwa bugayaavu, wabula kikuumi eri okuggwaamu essuubi okuva mu kusuubira enkyukakyuka ey’omu kaseera kamu. Omusumba eyakitegeera yasobolanga okukwata ekisibo kye mu myaka emiwanvu egy’omu makkati g’obulamu bw’Omukristaayo n’essuubi erinywevu era erigumiikiriza.

Newton era yaleeta mu busumba bwe obusobozi obw’enjawulo obw’okugumiikiriza abo b’ataakkiriziganyanga nabo. Yali Mukalvini eyagaana okukozesa endowooza ye eya Kalvini ng’ekyokulwanyisa; yali muntu wa Njiri eyakuuma enkolagana ey’obusumba n’abaalina endowooza ez’eby’obwakatonda ez’enjawulo ennyo. Empisa eno ey’emirembe yagisimba ku kuyigiriza kwa Pawulo eri Timoseewo: “Omuddu wa Mukama tasaana kulwana, wabula okuba omukkakkamu eri bonna, n’okuba omuyigiriza omulungi agumiikiriza, era aluŋŋamya n’obwetoowaze abo abamuwakanya, oboolyawo Katonda alibawa okwenenya, ne bamanya amazima” (2 Timoseewo 2:24–25). Obuweereza bwe obw’okubeerawo n’abantu — okukyalira abalwadde, abali kumpi n’okufa, abatabuddwa, n’abakungubaga — bwanywezebwa okumala emyaka kinaana olw’okukkiriza okwangu nti buli mwoyo gwe yasisinkana gwagulibwa omusaayi gwe gumu ogwamugula ye. Teyalekaayo kwewuunya nti yasonyiyibwa. Okwewuunya okwo kye kyali ensulo y’okusaasira kwe mu busumba. Obuweereza bwe bwalaga nti obwesigwa mu busumba tebuziyizibwa myaka, nsibuko, wadde byafaayo bya muntu — nti ekisa ekinunula omwonoonyi asinga obubi kye kisa kye kimu ekisaanyiza omusumba atasuubirwa n’akatono. Ekisa tekyafa bwereere mu John Newton. Kyamufuula omu ku basumba abasinga okusaasira n’okubala ebibala mu kyasa kye.

Essaala

Ayi Katonda ow’ekitalo, ow’ekisa ekisinga buli kibi kye twakola na buli kizikiza kye twabeeramu, tufuule abasumba abatalekaayo kwewuunya nti twasonyiyibwa. Bwe tukemebwa okulunda nga twetwala ku ntikko y’obutukuvu bwaffe, tuzzeeyo okujjukira bye twali ng’ekisa kyo tekinnatuzuula. Tuwe obukkakkamu bwa Newton eri abatawaana, okugumiikiriza kwe eri abagenda empola, n’obwetegefu bwe obutaggwaawo okugumya abalala n’okugumya kwe twafuna ffe ffennyini. Amiina.

Omuyaga ogw’entiisa mu 1748 gwaleeta akaseera akazibu akaatandika okukyuka kwe, era mu 1764 yayawulibwa okuba omuweereza mu Kkanisa ya England, n’aweereza ng’omusumba omuyambi e Olney mu Buckinghamshire okutuusa mu 1780. fields.title: Robert Murray M’Cheyne — Omusumba Omuto Omutukuvu ow’e Dundee
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Robert Murray M’Cheyne yazaalibwa nga May 21, 1813, mu Edinburgh, Scotland, ng’ye asembayo obuto ku baana bataano mu maka ag’omu makkati agaatyanga Katonda. Yakyuka ng’atandika emyaka amakumi abiri, n’asomera ku Edinburgh University ne New College, era mu 1836, ku myaka amakumi abiri mu esatu, n’ayawulibwa okuba omuweereza ow’olubereberye owa St. Peter’s Church e Dundee — ekkanisa empya mu kitundu ky’abakozi ekyalimu abantu nga enkumi nnya. Yaweereza eyo emyaka musanvu gyokka, n’afa omusujja gwa typhus mu 1843 ku myaka amakumi abiri mu mwenda, nga teyaddamu kuba mulamu bulungi oluvannyuma lw’obulwadde obw’amaanyi mu 1838–1839. Mu myaka egyo omusanvu yakyusa St. Peter’s, n’awandiika ennyimba ezikyayimbibwa leero, n’agenda ku mulimu gw’obuminsani eri Abayudaaya ab’e Palestine, era n’azimba omukago gw’okusaba ogwamuwangaala. Ekitabo kya Andrew Bonar “Memoir and Remains of Robert Murray M’Cheyne,” ekyafulumizibwa ng’amaze okufa, kyafuuka kimu ku bitabo by’obulamu bw’Abakristaayo ebyasinga okusomebwa mu kyasa ekya kkumi n’omwenda, era kyabumba emirembe n’emirembe gy’abaweereza.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Endowooza ya M’Cheyne ku buweereza bw’obusumba yafunzibwa mu sentensi esinga okumanyika gye yawandiika, ng’awandiikira omuyizi omuto eyali yeetegekera obuweereza: “Ekisinga okwetaagibwa abantu bange bwe butukuvu bwange bwennyini.” Kino tekyali kiragiro kya ddiini ey’okwekweka n’okwewala ensi; kyali by’obwakatonda bya busumba eby’omugaso ennyo. Oba ng’ekibiina kiriisibwa mu mwoyo omuweereza, olwo ebbugumu ly’omwoyo ery’ekibiina teryayinza kulema kubumbibwa ery’omusajja oyo. Omuweereza ow’omutima omunnyogovu yazaala ekibiina eky’omutima omunnyogovu. Omusajja abeera mu kukolagana okw’amazima ne Katonda yatwalanga okukolagana okwo naye ku kituuti, era ekibiina ne kikiwulira.

Okukkiriza kuno M’Cheyne yakusimba ku kubuulirira kwa Pawulo eri Timoseewo, kwe yatwala ng’okubuulirira kw’obusumba okusinga obukulu mu Ndagaano Empya: “Waleme kubaawo muntu n’omu akunyooma olw’obuvubuka bwo, naye mu kwogera ne mu bikolwa, ne mu kwagala, ne mu kukkiriza, ne mu bulongoofu beeranga kyakulabirako eri abakkiriza. Nyiikiranga okusomera abantu Ebyawandiikibwa mu lwatu n’okubuuliriranga, n’okuyigiriza okutuusa lwe ndijja. Togayaaliriranga ekirabo ekiri mu ggwe… Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza.

era obinywerereko. Bw’onookola bw’otyo olyerokola ggwe wennyini, era n’abo abakuwulira” (1 Timoseewo 4:12–16). Empisa n’ebyo by’oyigiriza wamu, nga tebyawukana: okwekuuma mu mpisa kwe kusooka, oluvannyuma ne kukulukutira mu by’oyigiriza. M’Cheyne yakeeranga buli nkya okumala essaawa ezisooka ez’olunaku ne Katonda nga tannasisinkana bantu be, ng’akakasa nti okumala ekiseera ne Mukama ku makya awatali kwanguyiriza kwe kwali okwetegeka okw’obusumba okusinga obukulu kwe yali ayinza okukola.

Okubuulira kwe okw’obusumba kwali kwa njawulo olw’okussa Kristo mu makkati. Yakkiriza nti buli kitundu ky’Ebyawandiikibwa ku nkomerero kisonga ku Kristo, era nti buli kubuulira, ka kube ku kyawandiikibwa ki, kulina okutuusa ekibiina ku Mulokozi. Teyafaayo ku kuyigiriza mpisa wadde okwekulaakulanya okwawukanye ku Kristo yennyini; yayagala abantu be bamanye Mukama Yesu, bamwagale era bamwesige mu kukolagana okw’oku lusegere okw’obuziba okukyusa obulamu bwabwe okuva munda okutuuka ebweru. Yakwata ku mutima okulangirira kwa Pawulo ku ngeri ye ey’obusumba: “Kubanga nasalawo obutamanya kintu kyonna mu mmwe wabula Yesu Kristo oyo eyakomererwa” (1 Abakkolinso 2:2). Kino tekyali kufunda kwa magezi, wabula magezi ga busumba: mu Kristo eyakomererwa mwe mwali obugazi bwonna obw’ebyetaago by’omuntu — okusonyiyibwa, okuwonyezebwa, essuubi, okumanya ky’ali, ekigendererwa, n’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Buli kye kibiina kye kyali kyetaaga kyali omwo.

Okulabirira kwa M’Cheyne kwatuuka n’okwagala okw’enjawulo ku bavubuka b’ekibiina kye.

Yateeka nnyo amaanyi mu baana n’abavubuka ba St. Peter’s, ng’azimba amasomero ga Ssande, ebibiina bya katekisimu, n’enkuŋŋaana z’abavubuka, ng’akakasa nti okubumba omwoyo gw’omulembe oguddako kye kimu ku bisinga okwanguyirizibwa mu busumba. Naye yennyini yakyuka akyali muto, era yategeera nti ekisa ekyamukwata nga bukyali kyandikutte n’abalala nga bukyali. Ekyokulabirako kye yakisanga mu Pawulo bwe yeewaayo eri Timoseewo: “Nzijukira okukkiriza kwo okw’amazima olubereberye okwali mu jjajjaawo Looyi ne mukadde wo Ewuniike; era nga nkakasiza ddala nga naawe okulina” (2 Timoseewo 1:5). Okukkiriza okuyisibwa mu nkolagana y’omuntu ku muntu okuva ku mulembe ku mulala kye kyali ekyokulabirako — era M’Cheyne yafuba okuba omutuusi w’okukkiriza ow’engeri eyo eri abavubuka b’e Dundee.

Obulwadde bwe mu 1838 — obwamuggya ku kibiina kye kumpi omwaka mulamba, era bwe yannyonnyola n’obulumi mu bye yawandiikanga buli lunaku — bwali kimu ku byasinga okumubumba mu busumba bwe. Mu bunafu bw’omwaka ogwo yategeera mu mubiri gwe kye yali ategedde edda mu by’obwakatonda byokka: nti amaanyi g’obuweereza tegasibuka mu maanyi ga muntu, era nti omuweereza omunafu eyeesiga Katonda ow’amaanyi asobola okukola ebisinga ku muweereza ow’amaanyi eyeesiga yekka.

Mu ebyo Pawulo bye yayitamu yasangamu ebigambo ebinnyonnyola ebibye: “Buli mulundi ng’aŋŋamba nti, ‘Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu.’ Noolwekyo kyennaavanga nneegulumiza n’essanyu lingi olw’obunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke galabisibwe” (2 Abakkolinso 12:9).

Okuzuukuka okusinga obunene mu byafaayo bya St. Peter’s kwabaawo M’Cheyne nga taliiwo — nga kukulemberwa William C. Burns ng’ali mu kuddamu amaanyi. Amawulire gano yagafuna n’essanyu ery’obwetoowaze, ng’agatwala ng’obukakafu nti omulimu tegwali gugwe okuva ku lubereberye.

M’Cheyne yafa ku myaka amakumi abiri mu mwenda. Yaleka emabega ekibiina ekikyuse, ennyimba nnyingi, enkola y’okwewaayo eri Katonda ku lulwe eyabumba abaweereza mu nsi yonna, n’enteekateeka ey’ettutumu ey’okusoma Bayibuli mukwano gwe Andrew Bonar gye yafulumya, era gye bakyakozesa leero — etwala abasomi mu Bayibuli yonna mu mwaka gumu, Endagaano Enkadde omulundi gumu n’Endagaano Empya emirundi ebiri.

Mu myaka musanvu yali asimbye ebyo obuweereza bungi bye butasimba mu myaka amakumi ataano. Yalaga mu bulamu bwe ekifaananyi Peetero kye yalaba eky’ebyo obulamu bw’obusumba bye buzaala: “Naye mwe muli kika kironde, bakabona bw’obwakabaka, eggwanga ettukuvu, abantu ba Katonda bennyini. Mwalondebwa mulyoke mutende ebirungi bya Katonda eyabaggya mu kizikiza n’abayingiza mu butangaavu bwe obutenkanika” (1 Peetero 2:9). Yali atenze ebirungi ebyo. Ekibiina kye kyabitenda oluvannyuma lwe. Era okubitenda tekunnakoma.

Essaala

Mukama Omutukuvu, tujjukize nti ekisinga obukulu kye tuyinza okukolera ebibiina byaffe kwe kuba abatukuvu ffe ffennyini. Bwe tuba nga twateeka emirimu mu kifo ky’okukolagana naawe, okweteeka mu bingi mu kifo ky’okwewaayo, oba amagezi g’enkola mu kifo ky’obutukuvu, tuzzeemu obuggya. Tufuule nga M’Cheyne — abasajja essaawa zaabwe ezisooka nga za ggwe, okubuulira kwabwe nga kujjudde Kristo, era ekyo kye basinga okwegomba nga si buweereza bunene wabula obutukuvu. Era tuwe okwesiga nti omulimu bwe guba nga gugwo ddala, gulituwangaalira. Amiina.

Omuweereza ow’omutima omunnyogovu yazaala ekibiina eky’omutima omunnyogovu. Omusajja abeera mu kukolagana okw’amazima ne Katonda yatwalanga okukolagana okwo naye ku kituuti, era ekibiina ne kikiwulira. Okukkiriza kuno M’Cheyne yakusimba ku kubuulirira kwa Pawulo eri Timoseewo, kwe yatwala ng’okubuulirira kw’obusumba okusinga obukulu mu Ndagaano Empya: “Waleme kubaawo muntu n’omu akunyooma olw’obuvubuka bwo, naye mu kwogera ne mu bikolwa, ne mu kwagala, ne mu kukkiriza, ne mu bulongoofu beeranga kyakulabirako eri abakkiriza. Nyiikiranga okusomera abantu Ebyawandiikibwa mu lwatu n’okubuuliriranga, n’okuyigiriza okutuusa lwe ndijja. Togayaaliriranga ekirabo ekiri mu ggwe… Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza. era obinywerereko. Bw’onookola bw’otyo olyerokola ggwe wennyini, era n’abo abakuwulira” (1 Timoseewo 4:12–16). Empisa n’ebyo by’oyigiriza wamu, nga tebyawukana: okwekuuma mu mpisa kwe kusooka, oluvannyuma ne kukulukutira mu by’oyigiriza. M’Cheyne yakeeranga buli nkya okumala essaawa ezisooka ez’olunaku ne Katonda nga tannasisinkana bantu be, ng’akakasa nti okumala ekiseera ne Mukama ku makya awatali kwanguyiriza kwe kwali okwetegeka okw’obusumba okusinga obukulu kwe yali ayinza okukola. Okubuulira kwe okw’obusumba kwali kwa njawulo olw’okussa Kristo mu makkati. Yakkiriza nti buli kitundu ky’Ebyawandiikibwa ku nkomerero kisonga ku Kristo, era nti buli kubuulira, ka kube ku kyawandiikibwa ki, kulina okutuusa ekibiina ku Mulokozi. Teyafaayo ku kuyigiriza mpisa wadde okwekulaakulanya okwawukanye ku Kristo yennyini; yayagala abantu be bamanye Mukama Yesu, bamwagale era bamwesige mu kukolagana okw’oku lusegere okw’obuziba okukyusa obulamu bwabwe okuva munda okutuuka ebweru. Yakwata ku mutima okulangirira kwa Pawulo ku ngeri ye ey’obusumba: “Kubanga nasalawo obutamanya kintu kyonna mu mmwe wabula Yesu Kristo oyo eyakomererwa” (1 Abakkolinso 2:2). Kino tekyali kufunda kwa magezi, wabula magezi ga busumba: mu Kristo eyakomererwa mwe mwali obugazi bwonna obw’ebyetaago by’omuntu — okusonyiyibwa, okuwonyezebwa, essuubi, okumanya ky’ali, ekigendererwa, n’obulamu obutaggwaawo. Buli kye kibiina kye kyali kyetaaga kyali omwo. Okulabirira kwa M’Cheyne kwatuuka n’okwagala okw’enjawulo ku bavubuka b’ekibiina kye. Yateeka nnyo amaanyi mu baana n’abavubuka ba St. Peter’s, ng’azimba amasomero ga Ssande, ebibiina bya katekisimu, n’enkuŋŋaana z’abavubuka, ng’akakasa nti okubumba omwoyo gw’omulembe oguddako kye kimu ku bisinga okwanguyirizibwa mu busumba. Naye yennyini yakyuka akyali muto, era yategeera nti ekisa ekyamukwata nga bukyali kyandikutte n’abalala nga bukyali. Okukkiriza okuyisibwa mu nkolagana y’omuntu ku muntu okuva ku mulembe ku mulala kye kyali ekyokulabirako — era M’Cheyne yafuba okuba omutuusi w’okukkiriza ow’engeri eyo eri abavubuka b’e Dundee. Obulwadde bwe mu 1838 — obwamuggya ku kibiina kye kumpi omwaka mulamba, era bwe yannyonnyola n’obulumi mu bye yawandiikanga buli lunaku — bwali kimu ku byasinga okumubumba mu busumba bwe. Mu bunafu bw’omwaka ogwo yategeera mu mubiri gwe kye yali ategedde edda mu by’obwakatonda byokka: nti amaanyi g’obuweereza tegasibuka mu maanyi ga muntu, era nti omuweereza omunafu eyeesiga Katonda ow’amaanyi asobola okukola ebisinga ku muweereza ow’amaanyi eyeesiga yekka. Mu ebyo Pawulo bye yayitamu yasangamu ebigambo ebinnyonnyola ebibye: “Buli mulundi ng’aŋŋamba nti, ‘Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu.’ Noolwekyo kyennaavanga nneegulumiza n’essanyu lingi olw’obunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke galabisibwe” (2 Abakkolinso 12:9). Okuzuukuka okusinga obunene mu byafaayo bya St. Peter’s kwabaawo M’Cheyne nga taliiwo — nga kukulemberwa William C. Burns ng’ali mu kuddamu amaanyi. Amawulire gano yagafuna n’essanyu ery’obwetoowaze, ng’agatwala ng’obukakafu nti omulimu tegwali gugwe okuva ku lubereberye. M’Cheyne yafa ku myaka amakumi abiri mu mwenda. Yaleka emabega ekibiina ekikyuse, ennyimba nnyingi, enkola y’okwewaayo eri Katonda ku lulwe eyabumba abaweereza mu nsi yonna, n’enteekateeka ey’ettutumu ey’okusoma Bayibuli mukwano gwe Andrew Bonar gye yafulumya, era gye bakyakozesa leero — etwala abasomi mu Bayibuli yonna mu mwaka gumu, Endagaano Enkadde omulundi gumu n’Endagaano Empya emirundi ebiri. Mu myaka musanvu yali asimbye ebyo obuweereza bungi bye butasimba mu myaka amakumi ataano. Yalaga mu bulamu bwe ekifaananyi Peetero kye yalaba eky’ebyo obulamu bw’obusumba bye buzaala: “Naye mwe muli kika kironde, bakabona bw’obwakabaka, eggwanga ettukuvu, abantu ba Katonda bennyini. Bwe tuba nga twateeka emirimu mu kifo ky’okukolagana naawe, okweteeka mu bingi mu kifo ky’okwewaayo, oba amagezi g’enkola mu kifo ky’obutukuvu, tuzzeemu obuggya. Tufuule nga M’Cheyne — abasajja essaawa zaabwe ezisooka nga za ggwe, okubuulira kwabwe nga kujjudde Kristo, era ekyo kye basinga okwegomba nga si buweereza bunene wabula obutukuvu. Era tuwe okwesiga nti omulimu bwe guba nga gugwo ddala, gulituwangaalira. Amiina.

fields.title: A.W. Tozer — Nnabbi ku Kituuti ky’Okubuulira
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

Aiden Wilson Tozer yazaalibwa nga 21 April 1897, ku faamu mu Newburg, Pennsylvania, n’afuuka Omukristaayo ku myaka kkumi na musanvu bwe yawulira omubuulizi ow’oku nguudo mu Akron, Ohio. Teoloji yagiyiga yekka — teyasomako mu sseminari wadde ku ttendekero lya waggulu — n’aawulwa okuba omuweereza mu Christian and Missionary Alliance mu 1920. Yali musumba wa Southside Alliance Church mu Chicago okuva mu 1928 okutuuka mu 1959 — emyaka amakumi asatu mu gumu — n’oluvannyuma mu Avenue Road Church mu Toronto okutuusa lwe yafa mu 1963 ku myaka nkaaga mu mukaaga. Yamala emyaka mingi ng’alongoosa “Alliance Life”, era yawandiika ebitabo ebisukka amakumi ana; ekisinga okutiikirira ye “The Pursuit of God” (1948), abangi kye batwala ng’ekitabo eky’Ekikristaayo ekitaggwaako mulembe. Yamanyibwa nga “eddoboozi erya bunnabbi” mu kkanisa ey’enjiri ey’omu mirembe gye — omusajja eyayogeranga abalala kye baali batayagala kwogera, eyalaba bulungi ekkanisa we yeegatta n’ensi, n’abyatula mu lwatu.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Okulaba kwa Tozer ku busumba kwali kwa nnabbi-omusumba: atakoma ku kuddukanya kitongole kya ddiini, wabula akuuma obulongoofu bw’omwoyo obw’abantu b’aweereza. Mu buweereza bwe bwonna yatya nnyo nti Obukristaayo bw’enjiri obw’e Amerika bwali mu kabi ak’okuwaanyisa okunoonya Katonda okw’amazima n’eddiini ey’okwewummuza, etaalina ky’esaba era etaakyusa muntu n’omu. Ebitabo bye n’okubuulira kwe byali nduulu ya musumba — ey’amangu, oluusi esongovu, naye bulijjo nga esibuka mu kukakasa nti ekkanisa ya Yesu Kristo yali egendereddwamu okuba eky’amaanyi era eky’ekitiibwa ennyo okusinga ekyo abasinga obungi ku b’omu yo kye baali bamativu nakyo.

Ekyawandiikibwa ekyali omusingi gw’obusumba bwa Tozer kye kyali n’ebyafaayo by’obulamu bwe: okulangirira okukulu okwa Pawulo mu Abafiripi, nti ekigendererwa ekyamumalira obulamu bwe tekyali kutuuka ku buwanguzi wabula kumanya: “Njagala okussa ekimu mu bibonoobono bye, nga mmufaanana mu kufa kwe, mmumanye era ntegeere amaanyi g’okuzuukira kwe, nga nsuubira nga nange ndizuukira.” (Abafiripi 3:10–11). Obuvunaanyizibwa bw’omusumba obusooka tebwali kuzimba nteekateeka, kukuza kibiina, oba kuleeta bibala bya kwolesa, wabula kumanya Katonda. Ebirala byonna — okubuulira, okubuulirira, okuddukanya, okubuulira enjiri — byava mu kumanya okwo.

Omusumba atali ye kennyini mu kunoonya Katonda okw’amazima yali agaba ku bintu bye yeewola, era byandimuggwako lumu.

Yalaba nga nnabbi engeri obuwangwa bw’okusanyusa abantu gye bwali bweyingiza mu kusinza kw’ekkanisa.

Dda mu myaka gya 1950, yalaba ekkanisa ng’ewunjuka okudda eri eby’okwolesa n’okuva ku kusisinkana Katonda okw’amazima — okuwunjuka okwazza ekinyumu ky’eby’eddiini mu kifo ky’obuzito bw’okusisinkana Katonda. Eddagala yalisanga mu kulangirira kwa Yesu yennyini ku kusinza okw’amazima bwe kuli: “Naye ekiseera kijja, era kituuse, abo abasinziza mu mazima bwe banaasinzizanga Kitaffe mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Kubanga Kitaffe anoonya abo abamusinza era n’abo abamusinza kibagwanira okumusinzanga mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Kubanga Katonda Mwoyo n’abo abamusinza kibagwanira okumusinza mu mwoyo ne mu mazima.” (Yokaana 4:23–24). Mu mwoyo ne mu mazima: byombi, wamu, nga tebyawukana. Okusanyusa abantu tekuyinza kuleeta na kimu ku byo. Omwoyo wa Katonda yekka, ng’akolera mu mazima g’Ekigambo kya Katonda, ye yali asobola okuleeta okusinza Katonda kw’anoonya ddala.

Enjigiriza ya Tozer ku kubeerawo kwa Katonda yava mu bumanyirivu bwe ng’anoonya Katonda mu buziba bw’okusaba okw’okufumiitiriza. Yasoma nnyo ebiwandiiko by’Abakristaayo ab’okufumiitiriza — Brother Lawrence, François Fénelon, Teresa ow’e Ávila, Meister Eckhart — n’asangamu ennono ey’okumanya Katonda mu bumanyirivu, gye yakkiriza nti ekkanisa ey’enjiri yali emaze okugireka ennyo. Okwolesebwa kwa Isaaya yakufuula ekipimo kya buli buweereza bw’obusumba obw’amazima: “Awo mu mwaka kabaka Uzziya mwe yafiira, nalaba Mukama ng’atudde ku ntebe empanvu ng’agulumizibbwa, n’ekirenge ky’ekyambalo kye nga kijjula yeekaalu.” (Isaaya 6:1). Omusumba eyali alabye Mukama nga Isaaya bwe yamulaba — mu butukuvu bwe, mu kitiibwa kye, mu kubeerawo kwe okwokya ng’omuliro — teyandimatidde kuwa kibiina kye kitono ku ekyo. Okwolesebwa okwo gwe musingi gw’obuweereza bwonna obw’obusumba obwa bunnabbi obw’amazima.

Mu ngeri y’emu yeeraliikirira kye yayita “omutego gw’okwagalibwa” mu buweereza bw’obusumba — okukemebwa okutakoma okw’okwogera ebisiimibwa okusinga ebyetaaga okwogerwa. Tozer yasomanga obuwangwa bw’omu kiseera kye n’obwegendereza, era okweyongera kw’omuwendo tekwamulimba. Okulabula kwa Pawulo yakutegeera ng’akabi akatakoma mu busumba, so si ak’omu biseera eby’omu maaso kwokka: “Kubanga ekiseera kijja lwe baligaana okuwulira enjigiriza entuufu, era olw’okugoberera okwegomba kwabwe balyekuŋŋaanyiza abayigiriza, abalibayigiriza bye baagala, okuwulira. Baligaana okuwuliriza eby’amazima, ne bagoberera enfumo obufumo.” (2 Timoseewo 4:3–4).

Omusumba eyagalibwa ennyo, bwe yalabula, y’atera okuba ow’akabi okusinga — si lwa nti ebibiina bye byali binene, wabula lwa nti obunene bwabyo bwali busobola okulimba nti buli kimu kiri bulungi, so nga Omwoyo yali yava dda awo.

Obulamu bwe obw’obusumba obutaaliko kwejalabya bwennyini bwali kuyigiriza. Yabeeranga mu ngeri ya wansi, yagabanga ensimbi z’ebitabo bye, teyawaanyisa by’akkiririzaamu olw’okulinnyisibwa mu kitongole, era buli wiiki yamalanga essaawa nnyingi yekka ne Katonda, ekyabumba era ne kiwanirira buli kye yabuulira. Yali atadde ku mutima ekiragiro ekikulu ekiri mu mutima gwa Shema: “Yagala Katonda wo n’omutima gwo gwonna n’omwoyo gwo gwonna, n’amagezi go gonna, n’amaanyi go gonna.” (Makko 12:30). Yanoonya Katonda n’ebyo ebina byonna: n’omutima mu kwemalira, n’omwoyo mu kwewaayo, n’amagezi mu kusoma, n’amaanyi mu kwefuga. Teyali muntu atuukiridde. Naye yanoonya n’obunyiikivu Katonda atuukiridde — era okunoonya kwe kwayita ekibiina kye okukola kye kimu.

Essaala

Ayi Katonda, omuliro ogwokya, tununule mu bukuumi bw’obusumba obw’okwogera ebyo byokka ebibiina byaffe bye byagala okuwulira. Tuwe obuvumu bwa Tozer okwogera Omwoyo by’ayogera ddala, ne bwe biba tebinyuma. Zzaawo mu ffe enjala ey’okukumanya Ggwe — so si kumanya bumanyi ebikukwatako — era okunoonya kwaffe okubeerawo kwo kubeere omuliro ogutalabika ogubuguumya buli kye tukola mu buweereza. We twafuula ekkanisa ennyangu ennyo, ey’okwewummuza ennyo, era ey’okwesanyusa ennyo, zzaawo obuzito bw’ekitiibwa kyo. Amiina.

fields.body_html:

Oluvannyuma lw’omwaka ogwamubumba mu New York ku Union Theological Seminary ne mu Abyssinian Baptist Church e Harlem — gye yasanga Obukristaayo bw’Abamerika abaddugavu obw’omwoyo omuziba, bwe yalowooza nti ekkanisa y’Abaluteri mu Bugirimaani yali ebuziddwa ennyo — yaddayo e Bugirimaani okusomesa, okubuulira, era oluvannyuma okukulembera sseminari ya “Confessing Church” e Finkenwalde, etaakkirizibwanga mateeka, ng’awakanya ekkanisa y’e Bugirimaani eyali efugibwa Abanazi. Gestapo yamukwata mu April 1943, n’asibibwa emyaka ebiri mu kkomera lya Tegel e Berlin, era n’attibwa ng’awanikibwa mu nkambi y’abasibe e Flossenbürg nga 9 April 1945 — wiiki ssatu nga olutalo terunnaggwa. Ebitabo bye, nga mw’otwalidde “The Cost of Discipleship” ne “Life Together,” bibumbye endowooza y’Abakristaayo mu nsi yonna okumala emyaka kinaana.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Okulaba kwa Bonhoeffer ku busumba kwazaalibwa mu buzibu. Ekkanisa y’e Bugirimaani mu myaka gya 1930, ng’oggyeeko abatono abaategeerekeka, yali yeewaayo eri National Socialism — ng’ekkiriza gavumenti okugisalirawo enjigiriza yaayo, okugoba bammemba baayo Abakristaayo abaali Abayudaaya, n’okukaka obuweereza bwayo okuweereza endowooza y’eggwanga. Bonhoeffer yaddamu ng’anywerera — ng’ebbeeyi gy’asasula yeeyongera — nti obuwulize bw’ekkanisa ya Yesu Kristo obw’enkomerero tebwali bwa gavumenti wabula bwa Mukama waayo, era nti mu biseera eby’akabi obuweereza bw’obusumba bwali butegeeza okukkiriza okubonaabona olw’okwatula okwo mu kifo ky’okukwetabulamu.

Ekyawandiikibwa ekyali omusingi gw’obuweereza bwe bw’obusumba kwali kuyita kwa Kristo nga bwe kuwandiikiddwa mu Njiri ssatu ezifaanagana, kwe yannyonnyola mu bujjuvu mu The Cost of Discipleship. Okuyita kwa Yesu kwali kwa ddala era nga tekuliiko bukwakkulizo: kwetaaga okwawukana n’obwesigwa bwonna obwasooka, n’obukuumi bwonna obwasooka, n’endagamuntu yonna eyasooka. Bonhoeffer yalaga kye yayita “ekisa ekya layisi” — okubuulira okusonyiyibwa awatali kwenenya, okubatiza awatali kukangavvula kwa kkanisa, n’Ekyeggulo kya Mukama awatali kwatula bibi — ng’obuvundu obusinga obulabe obwali butunuulidde ekkanisa y’e Bugirimaani.

Ekyo yakiwakanya n’ebigambo bya Yesu: “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere. Kubanga buli agezaako okuwonya obulamu bwe alibufiirwa, oyo alifiirwa obulamu bwe ku lwange alibuwonya.” (Matayo 16:24–25). Omusumba eyabuulira ekisa ekya layisi teyali awa kibiina kye Bukristaayo obukakkamu; yali abawa eky’obulimba ekyandibalemeredde mu kaseera ddala we baali basinga okwetaaga eky’amazima.

Ekitabo kye Life Together — ekimpi, ekyakaayakana, ekinnyonnyola obulamu bw’ekibiina mu sseminari ye e Finkenwalde — ye yali teoloji ye ey’obusumba ku kibiina ky’Abakristaayo. Yategeeza nti ekibiina ky’Abakristaayo tekisaana kuzimbibwa ku kwagalana kw’abantu, ku mpisa ze bafaanaganya, oba ku kyangu eky’ekitongole, wabula ku Kigambo kya Katonda ne ku Yesu Kristo yekka. Buli kibiina ekizimbiddwa ku misingi gy’abantu kyandigudde lumu, ensobi z’abantu bwe zandisusse okugumiikirizibwa. Ekibiina ekisimbiddwa mu Kristo kyokka kye kyali kisobola okuwanirira okusonyiwagana okw’amazima, obwesimbu obw’amazima, n’okwagala okw’amazima. Ekyokulabirako yakisanga mu Pawulo bw’annyonnyola omubiri: “Kuba omubiri nga bwe guli ogumu, ne guba n’ebitundu bingi, ate ebitundu byonna ne byegatta ne biba omubiri gumu, kale, ne Kristo bw’ali bw’atyo.” (1 Abakkolinso 12:12). Omulimu gw’omusumba gwali kuzimba omubiri ogwo — so si kukuŋŋaanya bantu kinnoomu abamativu, abali ng’abaguzi.

Obuvumu bwa Bonhoeffer ng’omusumba mu maaso g’okunyigirizibwa gavumenti bwe bumu ku bujulizi obusinga okukebera omutima obw’obwesimbu bw’obusumba mu kyasa eky’amakumi abiri. Yafuna omukisa okusigala mu mirembe mu Amerika olutalo bwe lwatandika; wabula yaddayo e Bugirimaani, ng’amanyi ebbeeyi gye yandisasudde. Yakkiriza nti obuyinza bw’omusumba ku nkomerero bwesigama ku kuba nti mwetegefu okubonaabona olw’amazima g’abuulira — nti omusumba adduka emisege bwe gijja tali musumba n’akatono. Yanywerera ku kiragiro ky’Abaebbulaniya eri ebibiina: “Muwulirenga abakulembeze bammwe era mubagonderenga, kubanga obuweereza bwabwe kwe kulabirira emyoyo gyammwe, balyoke bakikole n’essanyu nga tebeemulugunya. Kubanga bwe babeemulugunyiza tekibagasa mmwe.” (Abaebbulaniya 13:17). Yawa ekibiina kye ensonga ey’okumwesiga ng’abeera omusumba ow’engeri eyo — eyalabirira ekisibo ng’asasula n’eddembe lye, era ku nkomerero n’obulamu bwe.

Ebiwandiiko bye eby’omu kkomera, ebyakuŋŋaanyizibwa mu Letters and Papers from Prison, biraga omutima gw’obusumba ogwagenda mu maaso n’okukola ne mu mbeera eyategekebwa okuguzikiriza. Ng’ali mu kasenge ke, yawandiikiranga ab’omu maka ge ne mikwano gye amabaluwa agabalung’amya mu by’omwoyo mu mazima. Yakulemberanga okusinza kw’abasibe banne n’abakuumi. Mu mabaluwa Pawulo ge yawandiika ng’ali mu kkomera — Abafiripi, Abakkolosaayi, Abaefeso — teyasangamu kubudaabudibwa kwokka, wabula n’ekyokulabirako ky’obuweereza bw’obusumba obukolebwa mu mbeera ezisinga okusiba ze tuyinza okulowoozaako. Yali anywezezza Pawulo kye yategeeza: “Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi.” (Abafiripi 4:13). Mu “byonna” bye yasobola okukola mu Kristo mwalimu n’okufa obulungi, era bw’atyo bwe yafa — ng’omusawo w’enkambi eyalaba ng’attibwa bwe yategeeza — n’obuteefu n’emirembe ebyewuunyisa n’abakuumi bennyini.

Ky’alekawo kye ky’omusumba eyagaana okwawukanya okukkiriza kwe okwa teoloji n’ebikolwa by’empisa, eyategeera nti ekkanisa okusirika mu maaso g’obutali bwenkanya nakyo kyennyini kwali kulemererwa mu busumba, era eyasasula obulamu bwe olw’okutegeera okwo. Yali abuulidde Amosi ne Mikka n’amaanyi mangi; n’afa ng’atuukiriza bye yabuulira. Okulaba kwa Peetero ku mulimu gw’obusumba yakutwala nga kukulu ddala: “Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe, mukiriisenga nga mukirabirira n’okwagala so si na kwemulugunya, nga mukolerera amagoba ag’obukuusa wabula olw’okujjumbira Katonda.” (1 Peetero 5:2). Yakijjumbira. Yakijjumbira okutuuka ku nkomerero.

Essaala

Mukama Yesu, eyawaayo obulamu bwo olw’endiga zo, tufuule abasumba abeetegefu okukola kye kimu. Ekkanisa we ekemebwa okuwaayo ekisa ekya layisi, tuwe obuvumu bwa Bonhoeffer okubuulira ebbeeyi y’okuba omuyigirizwa. Okunyigiriza kw’ensi we kutusindika eri okusirika okutuwummuza, tuwe amaloboozi agatayinza kusirisibwa. Era omulimu gw’obusumba we gututwala mu kiwonvu kyagwo eky’ekisiikirize, tuwanirire n’obukakafu nti Ggwe wakitambulamu okutusooka. Amiina.

fields.title: Martyn Lloyd-Jones — Omusawo Eyawonya Emyoyo
fields.body_html:
Yali Ani

David Martyn Lloyd-Jones yazaalibwa nga 20 December 1899 mu Cardiff, Wales, mutabani w’omulimi w’ente ez’amata eyasengula amaka ge oluvannyuma n’agatwala e London. Yalaga amagezi ag’ekitalo mu kusoma, n’asomera obusawo, era ng’aweza emyaka nga amakumi abiri mu etaano n’afuuka omuyambi omuto owa Sir Thomas Horder, omusawo w’ab’olulyo olulangira era omusawo eyasinga okutiikirira mu England. Yalabika ng’agenda kutuuka ku ntikko y’obusawo bw’e Britain. Wabula mu 1927 n’aleka omulimu gwe ogw’obusawo, n’akkiriza empeera okukendeera ennyo, n’afuuka omusumba w’ekkanisa entono ey’Abakongirigeshoni eyali enafuye, mu Aberavon, South Wales — ekibiina ky’abakozi abaasima eby’obugagga mu ttaka. Yaweerezaayo emyaka kkumi n’emu, n’oluvannyuma mu 1938 n’akkiriza okuyitibwa mu Westminster Chapel mu London, gye yabuulira emyaka amakumi asatu egyaddirira eri ebibiina by’abantu enkumi n’enkumi. Okuyiga kwe okwa Bayibuli ku Lwokutaano ekiro n’emiddiriŋŋanwa gye emiwanvu egy’okunnyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa — nga mw’otwalidde emyaka kkumi n’esatu ku bbaluwa ya Pawulo eri Abaruumi — byazaala ebitabo by’emboozi ze ebikyali mu bisinga okusomebwa mu nsi ezoogera Olungereza. Yafa mu 1981 ng’aweza emyaka kinaana mu gumu.

Okwolesebwa Kwe ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba

Okulaba kwa Lloyd-Jones ku busumba kwabumbibwa okutendekebwa kwe mu busawo, era ekyo yakikkiriza mu buweereza bwe bwonna. Enkola y’omusawo — okwekenneenya obulungi endwadde nga tannawa ddagala, okufaayo ku nsibuko zaayo mu kifo ky’obubonero obw’okungulu, n’okugaana okuwa eddagala erikola ku kye balumiriza kyokka ng’endwadde ey’omunda tekomeddwako — yali, bwe yakkiriza, yennyini enkola eyetaagibwa ku musumba omubuulizi omwesigwa. Ekibiina ekiweebwa okubudaabudibwa awatali kwekebejjebwa kyali ng’omulwadde asiibulwa n’eddagala erikkakkanya obulumi so nga kye yali yeetaaga kulongoosebwa. Obuvunaanyizibwa bw’omusumba-omusawo obusooka bwali eri amazima g’obulwadde, so si eri okuwummula kw’omulwadde.

Ekyo Lloyd-Jones kye yali akakasa okusinga ku kubuulira — kye yatwala ng’ekikolwa ky’obusumba ekisooka — kwe kuba nti tekwali kutuusa bubaka bwokka oba wadde enjigiriza, wabula kintu ekibaawo nga Katonda yennyini ayogera okuyita mu Kigambo kye eri ekibiina ekikuŋŋaanye. Yalina teoloji etwala Ekigambo ekibuuliddwa ng’eddoboozi lya Katonda eddamu, eyesigama ku Pawulo bwe yannyonnyola engeri enjiri gye yaaniriziddwamu e Sessaloniika: “Naffe kyetuva twebaza Katonda obutayosa, kubanga bwe mwawulira ekigambo ekiva gye tuli, temwakiwulira ng’ekiva eri abantu wabula ng’ekiva eri Katonda, nga ky’ekigambo kya Katonda kyennyini, ekikolera ne mu mmwe, abakkiriza.” (1 Basessaloniika 2:13). Ekigambo kye kyali kikola — so si mubuulizi, so si mboozi, wabula Ekigambo kyennyini, ekiramu era ekikola mu abo abakyaniriza. Omulimu gw’omubuulizi gwali kuva mu kkubo ly’okukola okwo, Ekigambo kikole ekyo Ekigambo kyokka kye kiyinza okukola.

Emiddiriŋŋanwa gye emikulu egy’emboozi, okusingira ddala okunnyonnyola kwe Abaruumi, gyali kikolwa ekyagenda mu maaso eky’okulabirira omuntu yenna mu bulamba. Yakkiriza nti okubuulira enjigiriza, bwe kukolebwa obulungi, si kye kikontana n’ebbugumu ly’obusumba wabula kye kiraga ebbugumu eryo mu buziba obusingayo — kubanga abantu abaategeera obulungi ennyo enjigiriza z’ekisa, ez’okuweebwa obutuukirivu n’ez’okutukuzibwa, be baasinga okuba abeetegefu okugumira okubonaabona, okulwanyisa okukemebwa, n’okunyweza okukkiriza wansi w’okunyigirizibwa.
