fields.title: Okufundikira: Omusumba Omukulu Akyayita
fields.body_html:
Kaakano omaze ekiseera n’abasajja kkumi abaategeera omulimu gw’obusumba n’obukulu obunenya buli ngeri y’obuweereza ey’okwewummuza eyazze egolokoka okuva mu mirembe gyabwe. Chrysostom yatunda olubiri lw’omulabirizi era n’agenda okufa mu kifo ky’okuwaanawaana ab’obuyinza. Gregory yafuga ekkanisa ey’ebugwanjuba ng’alina ekitiibwa “Omuweereza w’abaweereza.” George Herbert yakyusa ekigo kye ekitono mu myaka esatu, n’afa nga tannalaba makungula. Richard Baxter yakyalira buli maka mu Kidderminster, n’alaba ekibuga kyonna nga kifuuka ekibiina ky’abasinza. Jonathan Edwards yabuulira abantu be okuteesa kwa Katonda kwonna okumala emyaka amakumi abiri mu esatu, n’agobebwa olw’okukikola n’obwesimbu. John Newton yamala obulamu bwe bwonna ng’agaba ekisa ekyamuzuula, wadde nga kyali tekisuubirwa n’akatono. Robert Murray M’Cheyne yafuka obuweereza obutukuvu mu myaka musanvu, n’afa ng’aweza amakumi abiri mu mwenda. A.W. Tozer yamala emyaka amakumi asatu mu gumu mu kkanisa emu e Chicago ng’agaana okubuulira ebyo omulembe bye gwali gwagala okuwulira. Dietrich Bonhoeffer yava mu bukuumi n’adda mu kabi, n’azimba ekibiina eky’obuyigirizwa obw’amazima, n’afiira ku kalabba n’emirembe. Martyn Lloyd-Jones yabuulira ebbaluwa yonna eri Abaruumi okumala emyaka kkumi n’esatu, n’alekera Ekigambo okukola ekyo Ekigambo kyokka kye kiyinza okukola.

Abasajja bano ekkumi batuyita kukola ki? Batuyita, okusooka n’okusinga byonna, okutwala ekifo ky’obusumba nga kikulu. Okulabirira emyoyo si mulimu gwa kuddukanya, wadde ekifo kya kulinnyiramu. Kuyitibwa okw’okutuukiriza, ne bwe kiba kya bbeeyi ki, mu bwesigwa eri Oyo eyayita. Ekisibo si kya musumba; kyagulibwa n’omusaayi ogutali gugwe, era kyamukwasibwa Omusumba ebipimo bye bye bya Kitaffe eyawaayo Omwana we ku lwa buli ndiga kinnoomu. Okukwata obuvunaanyizibwa obwo mu bulagajjavu kwe kulagajjalira teoloji, era abasajja bano ekkumi tebandikutwalidde ddala kuba buweereza bwa busumba.

Era batuyita okubudaabudibwa ekisuubizo. Omusumba Omukulu akyaliwo. Katonda oyo yennyini eyawa Chrysostom amaanyi okugumira obuwaŋŋanguse, eyawa Gregory amagezi okulabirira abantu ab’engeri ebikumi munaana ez’enjawulo, eyawanirira M’Cheyne mu bulwadde, eyatambula ne Bonhoeffer mu kizikiza ky’e Flossenbürg — Katonda oyo ye Katonda ayita buli musumba leero, era asuubiza okuwa buli gw’ayita bye yeetaaga. Omuwandiisi w’Abaebbulaniya akyogera mu bujjuvu obuggya omukka: “Kale, Katonda ow’emirembe eyazuukiza Mukama waffe Yesu, Omusumba w’endiga omukulu ow’endagaano etaggwaawo gye yanyweza n’omusaayi gwe, abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe” (Abaebbulaniya 13:20–21). Omusumba w’endiga omukulu ali wano.

Akyawa amaanyi. Akyakola. Omulimu gw’obusumba si lugendo lwa musajja yekka n’ekibiina kye; kukolera wamu wakati w’omusumba omuntu aweereza wansi we n’Omusumba Omukulu owa Katonda, ateebaka, atalekerera kisibo kye, era ekisa abaweereza be kye beetaaga tekimuggwaako.

Oboolyawo osoma ekitabo kino ng’omusumba akooye. Omulimu muwanvu, ebibala oluusi tebirabika, era obuzito bw’emyoyo gy’olabirira bukunyigiriza mu ngeri abakwetoolodde gye batasobola kutegeera bulungi. Abasajja ekkumi abali mu kitabo kino baali bamanyi obuzito obwo. Tebaabusitula lwa kuba ba kitalo; baabusitula nga baddanga buli kiseera eri Oyo eyabayita okubusitula, nga babukwasa emikono egy’amaanyi egisobola okubwetikka. Baasaba, baasoma, baasigala, era beesiga.

Oboolyawo osoma kino ng’omuntu atannaba mu kifo ky’obusumba naye awulira okuyitibwa nga kutandika okukuyuunga. Omusumba oyo eyayita abasajja bano ekkumi akyayita. Akyanoonya abasajja n’abakazi abanaakkiriza ekisibo kye n’okussaamu ekitiibwa, abanaakirunda n’obugumiikiriza, abanaakikuuma n’obuvumu, era abanaakimuddiza ku nkomerero n’ebigambo nti “Abo be wampa saabuzaako n’omu.” Ogwo gwe muluubirira ogw’obusumba ogusaanidde okubeera nagwo.

Okuyita tekukyuse. Ekisibo kikyetaaga okuliisibwa, okukuumibwa n’okukulemberwa. Emisege gikyali gya ddala. Endiga ezibula zikyabula. Era Omusumba Omukulu akyayogera ekiragiro kye kimu ky’azze ayogera mu buli mulembe: “lundanga endiga zange” (Yokaana 21:16). Ebigambo bisatu. Bimala obulamu bwonna. Abasajja ekkumi abali mu kitabo kino baabiwaayo obulamu bwabwe.

Naffe tukole kye kimu.

“Era ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala, abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera.”

— Yeremiya 3:15

Omuwandiisi w’Abaebbulaniya akyogera mu bujjuvu obuggya omukka: “Kale, Katonda ow’emirembe eyazuukiza Mukama waffe Yesu, Omusumba w’endiga omukulu ow’endagaano etaggwaawo gye yanyweza n’omusaayi gwe, abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe” (Abaebbulaniya 13:20–21). Omusumba w’endiga omukulu ali wano. Akyawa amaanyi. Akyakola. Omulimu gw’obusumba si lugendo lwa musajja yekka n’ekibiina kye; kukolera wamu wakati w’omusumba omuntu aweereza wansi we n’Omusumba Omukulu owa Katonda, ateebaka, atalekerera kisibo kye, era ekisa abaweereza be kye beetaaga tekimuggwaako. Oboolyawo osoma ekitabo kino ng’omusumba akooye. Omulimu muwanvu, ebibala oluusi tebirabika, era obuzito bw’emyoyo gy’olabirira bukunyigiriza mu ngeri abakwetoolodde gye batasobola kutegeera bulungi. Abasajja ekkumi abali mu kitabo kino baali bamanyi obuzito obwo. Tebaabusitula lwa kuba ba kitalo; baabusitula nga baddanga buli kiseera eri Oyo eyabayita okubusitula, nga babukwasa emikono egy’amaanyi egisobola okubwetikka. Baasaba, baasoma, baasigala, era beesiga. Oboolyawo osoma kino ng’omuntu atannaba mu kifo ky’obusumba naye awulira okuyitibwa nga kutandika okukuyuunga. Omusumba oyo eyayita abasajja bano ekkumi akyayita. Akyanoonya abasajja n’abakazi abanaakkiriza ekisibo kye n’okussaamu ekitiibwa, abanaakirunda n’obugumiikiriza, abanaakikuuma n’obuvumu, era abanaakimuddiza ku nkomerero n’ebigambo nti “Abo be wampa saabuzaako n’omu.” Ogwo gwe muluubirira ogw’obusumba ogusaanidde okubeera nagwo. Okuyita tekukyuse. Ekisibo kikyetaaga okuliisibwa, okukuumibwa n’okukulemberwa. Emisege gikyali gya ddala. Endiga ezibula zikyabula. Era Omusumba Omukulu akyayogera ekiragiro kye kimu ky’azze ayogera mu buli mulembe: “lundanga endiga zange” (Yokaana 21:16). Ebigambo bisatu. Bimala obulamu bwonna. Abasajja ekkumi abali mu kitabo kino baabiwaayo obulamu bwabwe. Naffe tukole kye kimu. “Era ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala, abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera.” — Yeremiya 3:15

fields.title: Ekyongerezeddwako ky’Ebyawandiikibwa: Ekigambo kya Katonda ku Kuyitibwa okw’Obusumba
fields.body_html:
Ebyawandiikibwa bino wammanga ebikwata ku buweereza bw’obusumba n’okulunda ekisibo bijuliziddwa mu kitabo kino kyonna. Mu Luganda, ebyawandiikibwa byonna biggiddwa mu Bayibuli y’Oluganda ey’Ennaku Zino, okuggyako nga kirambikiddwa mu ngeri endala.

Ennyanjula

Isaaya 40:11 — “Aliisa ekisibo kye ng’omusumba, akuŋŋaanya abaana b’endiga mu mukono gwe n’abasitula mu kifuba kye, n’akulembera mpola mpola ezibayonsa.”

Ezeekyeri 34:2–4 — “Zibasanze abasumba ba Isirayiri abeefaako bokka. Abasumba tebasaanye kuliisa ndiga? Mulya amasavu, ne mwambala ebyoya, ne mutta ensolo ensava, naye temufaayo ku bisibo. Ennafu temuzizzaamu maanyi, so n’endwadde temuzijjanjabye, so n’ezirumizibbwa temusibye biwundu byazo, so n’ezibuze temuzikomezzaawo.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28 — “Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna Mwoyo Mutukuvu mwe yabateeka okuba abalabirizi okulabiriranga Ekkanisa ya Katonda gye yeegulira n’omusaayi gwe.”

1 Peetero 5:2–4 — “Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe, mukiriisenga nga mukirabirira n’okwagala so si na kwemulugunya, nga mukolerera amagoba ag’obukuusa wabula olw’okujjumbira Katonda. Be mukulembera temubakambuwaliranga wabula mubakulemberenga nga mubalaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi. Era Omusumba Omukulu bw’alikomawo, muliweebwa engule ey’ekitiibwa ekitaliggwaawo.”

Essuula 1 — John Chrysostom

Yokaana 10:11–12 — “Nze musumba omulungi. Omusumba omulungi awaayo obulamu bwe olw’endiga. Omupakasi, atali musumba, endiga nga si zize, bw’alaba omusege nga gujja adduka n’aleka awo endiga.”

2 Timoseewo 4:2 — “buuliranga ekigambo kya Katonda, ng’oli mwetegefu mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu, ng’olaga ebikwekeddwa, ng’onenya, ng’ozaamu amaanyi, wakati mu kugumiikiriza, n’okubonaabona okungi, n’okuyigiriza.”

Abaggalatiya 3:28 — “Tewakyali kusosola wakati wa Muyudaaya na Muyonaani, wakati wa muddu na wa ddembe, wakati wa musajja na mukazi, kubanga mwenna muli omu mu Kristo Yesu.”

2 Timoseewo 4:3 — “Kubanga ekiseera kijja lwe baligaana okuwulira enjigiriza entuufu.

era olw’okugoberera okwegomba kwabwe balyekuŋŋaanyiza abayigiriza, abalibayigiriza bye baagala, okuwulira.”

Abafiripi 4:11 — “mu buli mbeera gye mbaamu nayiga okumalibwanga.”

Essuula 2 — Gregory Omukulu

Ezeekyeri 34:16 — “Ndinoonya ezaabula, ne nkomyawo ezaawaba. Ndigyanjaba ezaalumizibwa, ne ŋŋumya ennafu, naye ensava era ez’amaanyi ndizizikiriza. Ndirunda ekisibo mu bwenkanya.”

1 Abakkolinso 9:22 — “Mu banafu nafuuka ng’omunafu ndyoke mbaleete eri Kristo. Eri abantu bonna nfuuse byonna, mu ngeri yonna ndyoke mbeeko beentusa ku kulokolebwa.”

Matayo 20:26–28 — “Buli ayagala okubeera omukulu mu mmwe, abeerenga muweereza wa banne. Na buli ayagala okuba omwami mu mmwe aweerezenga banne ng’omuddu waabwe. Mube nga Omwana w’Omuntu atajja kuweerezebwa wabula okuweereza, n’okuwaayo obulamu bwe ng’omutango okununula abangi.”

1 Timoseewo 4:16 — “Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza era obinywerereko. Bw’onookola bw’otyo olyerokola ggwe wennyini, era n’abo abakuwulira.”

1 Peetero 5:3 — “Be mukulembera temubakambuwaliranga wabula mubakulemberenga nga mubalaga ekyokulabirako ekirungi.”

Essuula 3 — George Herbert

1 Basessaloniika 2:7–8 — “nga nnyina w’abaana bwe yandyagadde abaana be, bwe tutyo bwe twabalumirwa omwoyo ne tusanyuka okubatuusaako si Enjiri ya Katonda yokka naye n’okuwaayo emyoyo gyaffe ffe, kubanga mwafuuka baagalwa baffe.”

1 Timoseewo 3:2–3 — “Omulabirizi kimugwanira okuba nga taliiko kya kunenyezebwa, nga musajja wa mukazi omu, nga muntu eyeefuga, nga mwegendereza, nga mukwata mpola, ayaniriza abagenyi, era ng’amanyi okuyigiriza. Tateekwa kuba mutamiivu.”

Yokaana 3:16 — “Kubanga Katonda bwe yayagala ensi, bw’atyo n’awaayo Omwana we omu yekka, buli muntu yenna amukkiriza aleme kuzikirira, wabula afune obulamu obutaggwaawo.”

2 Timoseewo 2:24–25 — “Omuddu wa Mukama tasaana kulwana, wabula okuba omukkakkamu eri bonna, n’okuba omuyigiriza omulungi agumiikiriza, era aluŋŋamya n’obwetoowaze abo abamuwakanya, oboolyawo Katonda alibawa okwenenya, ne bamanya amazima.”

Abakkolosaayi 1:28 — “Kristo oyo gwe tutegeeza nga tuyigiriza buli muntu mu magezi gonna era nga tulabula buli omu, tulyoke twanjule buli muntu eri Katonda ng’atuukiridde mu Kristo.”

Essuula 4 — Richard Baxter

Ezeekyeri 3:18–19 — “Bwe ŋŋamba atali mutuukirivu nti, ‘Mazima tolirema kufa,’ n’otamulabula newaakubadde okwogera naye ng’omulabula alekeyo engeri ze ezitali za butuukirivu asobole okuwonya obulamu bwe, omuntu oyo atali mutuukirivu alifa olw’obutali butuukirivu bwe, naye omusaayi gwe ndiguvunaana ggwe.”

2 Timoseewo 4:1–2 — “Nkukuutirira mu maaso ga Katonda ne Kristo Yesu, anaatera okusalira abalamu n’abafu omusango, era n’olw’okujja kwe, n’olw’obwakabaka bwe, buuliranga ekigambo kya Katonda, ng’oli mwetegefu mu kiseera ekituufu n’ekitali kituufu.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:28 — “Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna Mwoyo Mutukuvu mwe yabateeka okuba abalabirizi okulabiriranga Ekkanisa ya Katonda gye yeegulira n’omusaayi gwe.”

Abaruumi 15:14 — “Era matidde baganda bange, nze kennyini, nga nammwe bennyini mujjudde obulungi, nga mujjudde okutegeera kwonna, era nga muyinza okubuuliriragana.”

Yeremiya 3:15 — “Era ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala, abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera.”

Essuula 5 — Jonathan Edwards

Abakkolosaayi 1:28–29 — “Kristo oyo gwe tutegeeza nga tuyigiriza buli muntu mu magezi gonna era nga tulabula buli omu, tulyoke twanjule buli muntu eri Katonda ng’atuukiridde mu Kristo. Kyenva ntegana nga nfuba nga nkozesa obuyinza Katonda bw’ampa obw’amaanyi.”

1 Basessaloniika 5:19–22 — “Temuzikizanga Mwoyo Mutukuvu, era temunyoomanga abo aboogera eby’obunnabbi, naye mwekenneenyenga ebintu byonna, kale bwe bibanga ebirungi mubinywezenga. Mwewalenga buli ngeri ya kibi.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:27 — “kubanga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mbabuulira okwagala kwa Katonda.”

Abaruumi 8:28 — “Era tumanyi nga eri abo abaagala Katonda, era abo abayitibwa ng’okuteesa kwe bwe kuli, ebintu byonna bibatuukako olw’obulungi.”

Abaefeso 4:15 — “Tube ba mazima mu kwagala, tulyoke tukulire mu Kristo mu byonna, nga tweyongera okuba nga ye, Omutwe gw’Ekkanisa.”

Essuula 6 — John Newton

1 Basessaloniika 2:7 — “Naye twefuula ng’abaana abato mu maaso gammwe, nga nnyina w’abaana bwe yandyagadde abaana be.”

Abafiripi 3:12 — “Sigamba nti mmaze okufuna oba nti mmaze okutuukirira, wabula nfuba okufuna ekyo Kristo Yesu kye yagenderera nfune.”

2 Timoseewo 2:24–25 — “Omuddu wa Mukama tasaana kulwana, wabula okuba omukkakkamu eri bonna, n’okuba omuyigiriza omulungi agumiikiriza, era aluŋŋamya n’obwetoowaze abo abamuwakanya, oboolyawo Katonda alibawa okwenenya, ne bamanya amazima.”

2 Abakkolinso 1:3–4 — “Katonda oyo Kitaawe wa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, Kitaffe ow’okusaasira era Katonda azaamu bonna amaanyi yeebazibwe, atuzaamu amaanyi mu kubonaabona kwonna kwe tuyitamu, tulyoke tugumye abalala abayita mu kubonaabona okwa buli ngeri, olw’okugumya kwe tufuna nga Katonda atuzaamu amaanyi.”

1 Abakkolinso 15:10 — “Naye olw’ekisa kya Katonda ndi nga bwe ndi kaakano, era ekisa Katonda kye yankwatirwa tekyafa bwereere.”

Essuula 7 — Robert Murray M’Cheyne

1 Timoseewo 4:12–16 — “Waleme kubaawo muntu n’omu akunyooma olw’obuvubuka bwo, naye mu kwogera ne mu bikolwa, ne mu kwagala, ne mu kukkiriza, ne mu bulongoofu beeranga kyakulabirako eri abakkiriza… Weekuumenga mu mpisa zo, ne mu by’oyigiriza era obinywerereko. Bw’onookola bw’otyo olyerokola ggwe wennyini, era n’abo abakuwulira.”

1 Abakkolinso 2:2 — “Kubanga nasalawo obutamanya kintu kyonna mu mmwe wabula Yesu Kristo oyo eyakomererwa.”

2 Timoseewo 1:5 — “Nzijukira okukkiriza kwo okw’amazima olubereberye okwali mu jjajjaawo Looyi ne mukadde wo Ewuniike; era nga nkakasiza ddala nga naawe okulina.”

2 Abakkolinso 12:9 — “Buli mulundi ng’aŋŋamba nti, ‘Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu.’ Noolwekyo kyennaavanga nneegulumiza n’essanyu lingi olw’obunafu bwange, amaanyi ga Kristo galyoke galabisibwe.”

1 Peetero 2:9 — “Naye mwe muli kika kironde, bakabona bw’obwakabaka, eggwanga ettukuvu, abantu ba Katonda bennyini. Mwalondebwa mulyoke mutende ebirungi bya Katonda eyabaggya mu kizikiza n’abayingiza mu butangaavu bwe obutenkanika.”

Essuula 8 — A.W. Tozer

Abafiripi 3:10–11 — “Njagala okussa ekimu mu bibonoobono bye, nga mmufaanana mu kufa kwe, mmumanye era ntegeere amaanyi g’okuzuukira kwe, nga nsuubira nga nange ndizuukira.”

Yokaana 4:23–24 — “Naye ekiseera kijja, era kituuse, abo abasinziza mu mazima bwe banaasinzizanga Kitaffe mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Kubanga Kitaffe anoonya abo abamusinza era n’abo abamusinza kibagwanira okumusinzanga mu mwoyo ne mu mazima. Kubanga Katonda Mwoyo n’abo abamusinza kibagwanira okumusinza mu mwoyo ne mu mazima.”

Isaaya 6:1 — “Awo mu mwaka kabaka Uzziya mwe yafiira, nalaba Mukama ng’atudde ku ntebe empanvu ng’agulumizibbwa, n’ekirenge ky’ekyambalo kye nga kijjula yeekaalu.”

2 Timoseewo 4:3–4 — “Kubanga ekiseera kijja lwe baligaana okuwulira enjigiriza entuufu, era olw’okugoberera okwegomba kwabwe balyekuŋŋaanyiza abayigiriza, abalibayigiriza bye baagala, okuwulira. Baligaana okuwuliriza eby’amazima, ne bagoberera enfumo obufumo.”

Makko 12:30 — “Yagala Katonda wo n’omutima gwo gwonna n’omwoyo gwo gwonna, n’amagezi go gonna, n’amaanyi go gonna.”

Essuula 9 — Dietrich Bonhoeffer

Matayo 16:24–25 — “Omuntu bw’ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere. Kubanga buli agezaako okuwonya obulamu bwe alibufiirwa, oyo alifiirwa obulamu bwe ku lwange alibuwonya.”

1 Abakkolinso 12:12 — “Kuba omubiri nga bwe guli ogumu, ne guba n’ebitundu bingi, ate ebitundu byonna ne byegatta ne biba omubiri gumu, kale, ne Kristo bw’ali bw’atyo.”

Abaebbulaniya 13:17 — “Muwulirenga abakulembeze bammwe era mubagonderenga, kubanga obuweereza bwabwe kwe kulabirira emyoyo gyammwe, balyoke bakikole n’essanyu nga tebeemulugunya. Kubanga bwe babeemulugunyiza tekibagasa mmwe.”

Abafiripi 4:13 — “Nnyinza okukola byonna mu oyo ampa amaanyi.”

1 Peetero 5:2 — “Mulundenga ekisibo kya Katonda ekiri mu mmwe, mukiriisenga nga mukirabirira n’okwagala so si na kwemulugunya.”

Essuula 10 — Martyn Lloyd-Jones

1 Basessaloniika 2:13 — “bwe mwawulira ekigambo ekiva gye tuli, temwakiwulira ng’ekiva eri abantu wabula ng’ekiva eri Katonda, nga ky’ekigambo kya Katonda kyennyini, ekikolera ne mu mmwe, abakkiriza.”

Abaruumi 1:16–17 — “Enjiri tenkwasa nsonyi: kubanga ge maanyi ga Katonda agalokola buli muntu akkiriza, okusooka eri Omuyudaaya n’eri Omunnamawanga. Kubanga mu yo obutuukirivu bwa Katonda bubikkulibwa.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 2:42–43 — “Ne banyiikiranga okuyigirizibwa kw’abatume ne mu kussekimu, ne mu kumenya omugaati era ne mu kusaba. Buli muntu n’ajjula okutya era ebyamagero bingi n’obubonero bungi ne bikolebwanga abatume.”

Ebikolwa by’Abatume 20:27–28 — “kubanga sirina na kimu kye nalekayo nga mbabuulira okwagala kwa Katonda. Mwekumenga era mukuumenga n’ekisibo kyonna Mwoyo Mutukuvu mwe yabateeka okuba abalabirizi okulabiriranga Ekkanisa ya Katonda gye yeegulira n’omusaayi gwe.”

Abaebbulaniya 12:1–2 — “Kale nga bwe tulina ekibiina ekinene eky’abajulirwa ekyenkana awo, twambulengamu buli ekizitowa, awamu n’ekibi ekitwesibako amangu, tuddukenga n’okugumiikiriza embiro ez’empaka ezatutegekerwa, nga tutunuulira Yesu eyatandika okukkiriza era y’akutuukiriza.”

Okufundikira

Abaebbulaniya 13:20–21 — “Kale, Katonda ow’emirembe eyazuukiza Mukama waffe Yesu, Omusumba w’endiga omukulu ow’endagaano etaggwaawo gye yanyweza n’omusaayi gwe, abawe buli kirungi kyonna kye mwetaaga okubasobozesa okukola by’ayagala, era atukozese ebisiimibwa mu maaso ge ng’ayita mu Yesu Kristo. Aweebwenga ekitiibwa emirembe n’emirembe.”

Yokaana 21:16 — “Kale lundanga endiga zange.”

“Era ndibawa abasumba abakola ng’omutima gwange bwe gwagala, abalibakulembera mu kumanya era ne mu kutegeera.”

— Yeremiya 3:15 ENKOMERERO
